Team: if you've been with us for a while, you know all about the voter suppression laws passed in states like Florida, Georgia, Texas, and more.

The bad news? It's working . Florida's law in particular has curtailed pro-voter organizations from hiring staff and helping people register to vote. It's also led to a downturn in their fundraising, making it harder for them to do their other work to defend voting rights.
Instead of coordinating volunteers to go door-to-door ahead of the election or sending them to events around these states to help register eligible voters, organizations like ours are stuck trying to figure out how to help people vote without incurring $250,000 fines. It's plainly unacceptable.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: What I learned from President Obama.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1767%2E135344%2EWyjoo7)

Friend,
I want to share a story about someone who, more than anyone, taught me the importance of listening and accountability.
It’s Barack Obama.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240812-3-900&t=2&akid=1767%2E135344%2EWyjoo7)
I was in the White House the first day he took office in 2009, serving as a part of his national security staff. I staffed his meetings in the Situation Room and briefed him in the Oval Office. Later, I was honored to be nominated by him to serve in the Pentagon.
Despite his effortless charm in public, President Obama was a very tough boss. I don’t think I’ve ever had a tougher boss than President Obama. He’s brilliant, and he’s got a lawyer’s training where he’ll grill you with difficult questions, one after another.
I learned pretty quickly to be prepared, because he was going to make sure you knew your stuff.
What’s more, he was going to hold you accountable to what you said. If you told him a fact or a plan, you’d better deliver on it. If you didn’t know something, you should say that and not try to fudge your way through it. That’s exactly the approach I try to take in Congress. I try my best to know the details, make thoughtful decisions, and be transparent about what I know and don’t know. Because I’ll never forget the lesson President Obama taught me: you better say what you mean, and mean what you say.
[**That’s the kind of Senator I’ll be. And I’m building a grassroots movement in that same spirit to bring accountability to the U.S. Senate. With that in mind, will you chip in$3 to help us get there?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240812-3-900&t=3&akid=1767%2E135344%2EWyjoo7)

**

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

body:
|
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=7235%2E5257348%2EUEhSD1)
Derek, it has been a _historic_ three weeks on the campaign trail.
**FIRST,** President Biden announced his withdrawal from the presidential race. He endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris in one of the most stunning acts of selflessness and love of country in political history.
**THEN,** Kamala built unprecedented momentum that put every state we need for 270 electoral votes back on the map. DNC delegates officially nominated her as the Democratic Party nominee as she selected Governor Tim Walz to be her running mate.
**NOW,** the Harris-Walz ticket is rallying crowds by the _thousands_ across the country, and Trump is terrified.

Some years later, I would become an Assistant United States Attorney, and successfully prosecute the first FBI agent charged with espionage, Richard Miller, for spying for the Soviet Union.
As a new graduate of law school, I could never have imagined I would handle a case like that.
Or that I would later investigate a president who also betrayed our country...
...lead his impeachment and Senate trial...
...serve on the January 6 Committee...
...get kicked off the Intelligence Committee by a craven Speaker of the House for doing the above...
...and get censured by extreme partisan MAGA House Republicans under the personal threat of that corrupt president.
Life leads us in uncertain and fortuitous ways. I’m fortunate that at a time when our country has been in trouble, and our democracy at risk, I have been in a position to help do something about it.
In the Senate, I hope to do even more.

I’m running against him as a political outsider because I believe in a future where our families, our jobs, and our values come first. But here’s the deal: we’re falling behind in the fundraising game, and we can’t afford to let Sherrod Brown’s millions drown out our message – because that’s what’s happening. For America, Bernie Moreno GOP Nominee for Senate, Ohio Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. | I have to be blunt, folks:

Mark Robinson poses a real threat to North Carolina’s future ... but he COULD win this toss-up race to be our next governor.

_The choice comes down to him or me._

[I’m asking you to join us in the fight to win this race and defeat Mark Robinson because the stakes are too high to lose. Split a donation between the Voter Protection Project and our campaign right now »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/74497?t=6&akid=16057%2E878179%2E8DuL2L)

I’ve spent decades serving our state. Advocating for our communities. Fighting for our people.

_And I’m ready to keep at it as North Carolina’s next Governor._

**Mark Robinson is a far-right extremist who isn’t interested in solving North Carolina’s problems, only fighting culture wars and advancing the most extreme right-wing policies.**

❌ A total abortion ban
❌ Defunding public schools
❌ Stoking conspiracy theories

THIS is what Mark Robinson stands for.

Folks, either Mark Robinson or I will be North Carolina’s next governor. I am ready to get to work to fight for strong schools, safer communities, and our most fundamental rights.

_But it’s up to you._

name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
Walworth County National Night Out, State Fair, Securing Our Elections, How to Vote Tomorrow, and a chance to help us out this Saturday in Janesville. | | | | |
---
| 85 days until Election Day. Here’s an update from the campaign trail:
**Walworth County National Night Out** It was great to join local law enforcement, fire departments, EMTs, and many local organizations and businesses for a fun night in Elkhorn last week.
---
| We even got a surprise appearance from Lt. Jim Dangle from the popular TV show Reno 911. I look forward to coming back next year!
**State Fair** The 173rd Annual Wisconsin State Fair was a blast! In my unbiased opinion, it’s the best State Fair in the country. If you haven’t been, I highly suggest making plans to attend next year.
---
| And of course, you can’t go to State Fair without stopping by the Milk House!
**Working to Secure Our Elections** Last week, I launched an investigation into the major Democratic fundraising platform ActBlue.
We found two key loopholes that we've identified within ActBlue that could enable money laundering and fraudulent donations.
Illegal and malicious conduct have no place in our elections.
If you're like me, you think there's too much money in our elections and not enough transparency. That’s why I'm working to bring more transparency to our elections.
---
[Click Here to Read More](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=b661240776&e=e907534017)
| **Election Day is Tomorrow!** If you haven’t already voted, make a plan to get to the polls tomorrow!
On the ballot, there will be 2 ballot referendums.
**I am encouraging you to vote YES on both referendums.**
By voting **YES** on both referendums, we can ensure that our state government retains the checks and balances laid out in the state constitution. For more information on the referendum questions, see the graphic below:
---
| **Super Saturday in Janesville** On Saturday, we’ll be knocking doors in Janesville and getting the word out about our conservative candidates.
We’re only 85 days out from Election Day and every vote is going to count.
---
| I hope to see you there!
On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil
---

2\. Door knock & build relationships with at least 10 out of 25 assigned voters.

**_Thank you for joining us each Tuesday for the "Conversations with the Candidate" Zoom event hosted by Women for Campbell. "Over the past several months, we have provided educational resources, informative materials, and real-life scenarios focused on supporting women and addressing their key concerns. This week marks the conclusion of our programming, and we are thrilled to present our final event, 'Overcoming Challenges': The Importance of Health, Insurance, and Housing Advocacy.' We encourage everyone to research Vote Yes on 4! - let's engage the candiate._**
**_Spotlight Discussion: "Challenges Don't Stop Us" | Special Guest Nardia McNeil "The Overcomer"_**
**At a young age, being diagnosed with Lupus and given only 3 months to live left me feeling defeated and disillusioned. Despite growing up in the church and believing in God, I struggled to reconcile my faith with the hardship I was facing. However, as I matured, I became determined to fight for my future and the promises I had made. | |
Dear fellow American, Time magazine published a story featuring the headline, "The Free Market is Dead: What Will Replace It?"

This is, of course, an exaggeration, but it makes clear the far-Left's goal--nothing less than a transformation of the world economy based on a rejection of economist Adam Smith's "invisible hand."

As the author writes, "We are on the cusp of a new era of broad-based prosperity in which our leaders are poised to more actively manage the American market."

Today's advocates of a "managed market" may call it by a new name--"The Great Reset"--but it is premised on an old and harmful idea.

What utopian ideologies like this one have in common is a misplaced faith in the rule of so-called experts and a corresponding disregard for the people's right to rule themselves. Taken to their logical conclusion, such ideologies can end only in **tyranny**.

The great British statesman Winston Churchill knew this, which led him to observe, "Nothing would be more fatal than for the government of states to get into the hands of the experts. Expert knowledge is limited knowledge: and the unlimited ignorance of the plain man who knows only what hurts is a safer guide, than any vigorous direction of a specialised character."

**In the fight to preserve our freedom, our greatest asset is education.** Americans who understand our country's founding principles and have a firm grasp of history are best prepared to resist the lure of utopian schemes.

**[That's why Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in our FREE MARKET SURVEY.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)**

Your answers will help us understand more clearly the views of mainstream Americans--not the so-called experts--concerning the importance of the free market system in our nation.

Please begin your survey below. Your answers will remain strictly confidential.

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/free-market-survey/](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)**

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

Dear fellow American, Time magazine published a story featuring the headline, "The Free Market is Dead: What Will Replace It?"

This is, of course, an exaggeration, but it makes clear the far-Left's goal--nothing less than a transformation of the world economy based on a rejection of economist Adam Smith's "invisible hand."

As the author writes, "We are on the cusp of a new era of broad-based prosperity in which our leaders are poised to more actively manage the American market."

Today's advocates of a "managed market" may call it by a new name--"The Great Reset"--but it is premised on an old and harmful idea.

What utopian ideologies like this one have in common is a misplaced faith in the rule of so-called experts and a corresponding disregard for the people's right to rule themselves. Taken to their logical conclusion, such ideologies can end only in **tyranny**.

The great British statesman Winston Churchill knew this, which led him to observe, "Nothing would be more fatal than for the government of states to get into the hands of the experts. Expert knowledge is limited knowledge: and the unlimited ignorance of the plain man who knows only what hurts is a safer guide, than any vigorous direction of a specialised character."

**In the fight to preserve our freedom, our greatest asset is education.** Americans who understand our country's founding principles and have a firm grasp of history are best prepared to resist the lure of utopian schemes.

**[That's why Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in our FREE MARKET SURVEY.](http://trk.secureandprosper.)**

Your answers will help us understand more clearly the views of mainstream Americans--not the so-called experts--concerning the importance of the free market system in our nation.

Please begin your survey below. Your answers will remain strictly confidential.

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/free-market-survey/](http://trk.secureandprosper._huvi8wXyVp5FiKKmGKg)**

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

subject: It’s time to roll up our sleeves and get to work
body:
Secure & Win, National Day of Action and say “no” to KOSA
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot-

---
| Did you know we are only **_six weeks_** away from early voting starting in some states? You probably thought we had until early October to start getting out the vote, right?**_But ... we don't!_** Because the Democrats have been successful in their efforts to weaken our voting system, it is now an election season, not a day.
What this means is simple: **_Your help is needed right now_** to start getting out the vote--not just in October. President Trump's victory hinges on you taking just a little bit of your time to mobilize other Trump supporters. It really is that simple.
**That 's why we have two fantastic opportunities for you to Get Out The Vote right now and beat the Democrats at their own game. _Note that one of the activities has a firm deadline of 11:59 pm EDT on Tuesday, August 13th -Today!-to sign up._****__**
---
| |
---
| ******NATIONAL DAY OF ACTION on AUGUST 22, 2024:
GET OUT THE VOTE FOR DONALD TRUMP!**On August 22nd, Kamala Harris is set to give her nomination acceptance speech at the Democrat National Convention in Chicago. We believe our time is best spent not worrying about their lies, but instead focusing on getting Trump supporters to pledge to vote.
To participate in the National Day of Action on August 22nd, **[please sign up here](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a422990d/1edb9794a42232f4 "https://forms.teapartypatriots.org/TPPatriots/form/Aug22ndDayofAction/formperma/O0fEnRLSzP8g3Tf04XW7DPQ2y8kp-Aw9ek-LUTxQpDk")**. Keep in mind that if you choose to send postcards, you must sign up by 11:59 pm EDT **_tonight_** , Tuesday, August 13th, as we'll be shipping the postcards out on the 14th. If you miss that deadline, don't worry--you can still sign up for phone banking.
Also don't forget to share this event and the **[sign-up link](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a422990d/1edb9794a42232f6 "the sign-up link")** with likeminded friends and family so that we can reach as many Trump supporters as possible during the DNC! **__****__**
---
| | [ SIGN ME UP ](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a422990d/1edb9794a42232f8)
---
| |
---
| ******MARCH TO VICTORY POSTCARD PROGRAM** If you'd like to send postcards but you can't participate on the National Day of Action, or you miss the sign-up deadline, no problem!
You can still join our Postcard Program outside of the August 22nd event. This program is straightforward: you'll send Get Out The Vote postcards to Trump-supporting voters to ensure they're motivated to vote.
Sign up for the **[March to Victory Postcard Program](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a422990d/1edb9794a42232fa "https://forms.teapartypatriots.org/TPPatriots/form/MTVPostcardProject/formperma/fsmtCLQsqvbH-e_PtQn0QiuYx5e547GaBD13NH0ukEs")**[ ,](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a422990d/1edb9794a42232fc) and we'll send the postcards directly to you. Each postcard already includes the voter's name and address. We'll also provide sample messages, though you're welcome to craft your own--just remember to include the voter's name in your message. **__****__**
---
| | [ SIGN ME UP ](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a422990d/1edb9794a42232fe)
---
| |
---
| ******** Also please send photos! Have someone else take a photo of you writing messages on the postcards, take a selfie with the completed postcards, take a photo of just the finished postcards, or however you'd like to do it. Then, text your photos to 470-413-6995. Your photos inspire others to volunteer, which means even more Trump voters are contacted, and more Trump votes are cast.
Once completed, purchase stamps and affix them to the postcards. When the postcards are ready, drop them in the mail. Please keep in mind that stamps are $0.73 each, so consider this cost when requesting postcards. A book of 20 stamps is $14.60 for reference.
And again, remember to [**share this link**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a422990d/1edb9794a4223300 "https://forms.teapartypatriots.org/TPPatriots/form/MTVPostcardProject/formperma/fsmtCLQsqvbH-e_PtQn0QiuYx5e547GaBD13NH0ukEs") with family and friends and help us make sure that every, single Trump supporter actually votes this year!
Thank you SO MUCH for everything you are doing this year and LET'S WIN THIS!!
In liberty,
Jenny Beth Martin **__****__**

## Trump Slams Biden in Musk Interview
Former President Donald Trump sat down with Elon Musk on Monday night for [a public conversation](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFutDAQBOCnMd2ezGKDr3DxN-7ub1Mi67wcmxgbYQO5t49InXqkTzPz8RgfniOn13-_kK1THv2z8kGjgbYDVKNqgp2IkLqGbDtgp7U2d93MtiOURitjUPcDBiKD7dRP5KfhrgfdNWxRopKm7VoptTI3fGo9aI-Esg_KBKEkBa55u31mTnWmKb7zQdvtmZcm2rnWtYjun0An0KX3mku9IoHuggU6aQS6FgW6vUCiswh0IScfA9RtX9YCnCptB9MJJ9cZKOYEy16-ICf4hsgHwb4GX6nARtf0nAr45OO78KU1mw3ryTFy6Qeh5GvxHH_71b_fOiz-BAAA__-DFmxz) airing live on Musk's "X" platform (formerly Twitter) on topics ranging from his assassination attempt to illegal immigration to international affairs and the 2024 election. The interview, spanning more than two hours, [was delayed by 40 minutes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vwyAUAH8N3rDwA_wxMHTxlq4dLWSe49eCsYCY5N9Xzdz5dDrpvm7LzZKn4_5pA5qyxcWuhS5cRt5JDmpRjTMbIqBs0HQDSK31OOlmN4BW9UNnndNq0xocbK5fO6kmLewEsiEDApQYO9kJodXYwqr1oC0giN6p0TEl0FGJqf2OdJQdN_-KF6Z2jaHxZi_lzEx-MJgZzLXWdovPA2v-4wzmgI4sg_nJA_qSuYv14CU9wsnDI_9kTkfBdBFWnk-7IqfwVgr6F1-TzTvmJhl3VvKecj8wJe7Bkn_3y_83LgO_AQAA__8WcGQe) due to what Musk described as a massive cyberattack. Despite the technical difficulties, the conversation drew more than 1.3 million listeners once it got underway. Trump expressed strong dissatisfaction with President Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris, saying they had failed the country on multiple fronts. He asserted that under his leadership, events like the October attack on Israel, the war in Ukraine, and high inflation would not have occurred.
## Hamas Backs Out of Peace Talks
Hamas [walked away from ceasefire](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAQQL8Gb1hwQEwHhi5s6drROvkOmxaHyKC47ddX6dz5Se_pvV_nK-aSb-sb7hx6qjMuPT949lIbCXa2A4XEDGwGDnoC45zzL27YwqSM1pbYgLHaJ4QFCOlCkEwiTWbIARRY5bXRSjnrR1icmxwCg7qQ9SSsYsq9HuNHzbe-cSrf9cHHuNR9KGHr_d6EeRUQBcTzPEf8yrU9qYD4dAuIyguIWguIK_6g3GrruLJcGBunfLAkxiI33LHJjuWzDUeg-5lLye0yCavWHXP5K_b__x8BfgMAAP__huxbmw) talks on Sunday, announcing it would not attend Thursday's final round of negotiations. The Palestinian [terror group cited](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2u3CAQRp8Gd7OCsfFPQZHG3aZNac3C2CbCYAFZy3n6q731rb9PR0fnz3N5kg8-br_pYFPXtJCt_s3LCKoF7JaucWZlRm4bNmrAVms9TrrZzdRPbT8RSzVJbVc94CBV_3K9Va_Wom68QYmdHFWrpNTd-ECr9aAJGWXvutGJTrLzNeXH3-Rj3XkNd3pzfth0NMHstZ5FtL8EzgLneJ-p1M8kcP6ABc5yFDgrJXC-Ug4OIl_lc-ULdjqogN09r3DTfhMUHy_KENMF57-y-7jBmjJYpsKw-szgmAL4CBv9J4Fzk407Lx-CL_0gOrkd5MO3W_251NvgVwAAAP__YMhpzg) the recent killing of its political leader, Ismail Haniyeh, and airstrikes in Gaza for pulling out. in American Greatness.

bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with

## Paxton Launches CenterPoint Investigation
Attorney General Ken Paxton [has opened an investigation](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L_upCAUxfGnwQ7DPwELim3sZtstDeBVyTBg8K7OvP1mtv_Vn5zk5PvnMT98yqlsv_0LHL7XOvuI6YLZUi6pULPqFhfYMvIOHDdCDgM3A-t2F8dhYdpoK5YVONdcBcsMG4KWQkZQXXKCCcUsl5wNWtpeS6m1DsJL74MZFVEMloS19bgDwtufa_7UC1of66vLbkc8TiJ_ETERMd333T_3-veLREy-YYoZiJgK3CcRU67R5y8g1lbgQzco0HymTyj08G-shUYoCO2oqSBN5YIT0-Yx1UIDtM93LexAJfDAVgkUuOFU2XWlwShL1aitV3y0wYauueW4U87p1IYotr18yv9_4w8ZLyf-BQAA__9ho3PO) into CenterPoint Energy's response to Hurricane Beryl last month, which left over 2.2 million Houston residents and businesses without power. CenterPoint [has taken heat](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OgzAQhJ_GdEb-w5DCRRq6pL0SLXgh1oGN7D1I7ulPSX_VjDTS6NP3dRtuENYQlzts6Og5pwEmCgcOHZeaKzOYyrtR-Ius0MlW6aaRbSOqh-v8ZLVH2bRWdDjPRnbCj1pccJLgO1MFp4QyopNaisbqrrZaW2tHBRpgbC-GGYE-UMo1PZDwCWVeX-nAXE9pq1b3INoL01emeqb68zzrrcT3xlSPkf8UpvqI5zs-_XPBYeHfGPkOT0qRpx1j4SEeWCgsQCFFHiIlPmEkzHsKkQofMb9WnrHsKRZkqofMr1eZerj_Vtn5_QzrGoptmRHLBmH9ENI_wg6n_gIAAP___71wXA) for neglecting vegetation management, not having enough line workers on standby before the hurricane, and failing to deploy mobile generators acquired after the 2021 winter storm. "If the investigation uncovers unlawful activity, that activity will be met with the full force of the law," Paxton [said in a statement](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1urDAQRp_GdEb-w0Dh4jZ0e9uUaAyzYMVrI3sCu28fZaWUqb7i05GOzsdtvkGIIW3_4YGOnvc8w0LhxHngUnNlZtOszot1lA062SvddbLvRLM70Y2DX4dOolXGG-h68Ot9kCiMtWYUTXBKKCMGqaXorB5aq7W11ivQAL4fDTMC10C5tLQj4RPqPb7yiaVd8qOJbic6KtP_mJqYmq7raj-fkH5OpqaEV2VqemO_y4Eol4QvvmHCApHnA1PlIZ1YKWxAISceEmW-YCIsRw6JKi9Yj5wqcsp8_yolLJCQeyyvyNTUFLceV4gxVNszI7YHhPhWpD-KnU59BwAA__-fpnHc). CenterPoint promised to cooperate with the investigation.
## Independence Creek Preserve Named National Natural Landmark
Independence Creek Preserve in West Texas was designated as the nation's [newest National Natural Landmark](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGTsyAUAH8NdjrwQNCC4mvs8rVXOk95iUwQHOA0-fc3l_7anS129us239AHHx__cSdbX_c041r9SfPQCtmCmlXj7MLdKBqywoDse2F63mzWCaEHpUZBw7gYcgMobWAEJwxqcKLxFjgoPggpeK_l0GkptdYLoERczKiY4uR8TbmrG1V6YbmHdzopd2vam2C3Wo_C5D8GE4Ppuq5ufxeMGGuKPv1KDKbg71TqOxCDKX1Xl1IuDCbM1a8f6KOjg6KjuFK7ZqJne2QqlE9qI1afIoY2YHQ75mcrRi2Ba-iO7WiydcflQ_BFG6b4Y0cfPm31j1WnhZ8AAAD__9HQbUU) last week. body:
I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well.

| | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zegp5dp91uk537osaopviu7ac4088rk0tluj3fuo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6clhmco31c9h2bs)
---
|
---
Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z7rdndfugagjvr9e62f5bqh95vgg5ort5adbg0io_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6clhmco31c9h2bs)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.
**_[Kamala Harris is raising millions, so today, I’m humbly asking you to chip in just $5 to get President Trump back in the White House.>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zfru7k5cs0pluug3amb5ue7k8mnukq98jmaq13s8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6clhmco31c9h2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zc6358ajbjugquvs9vt1k1q6vpdgkqd5ss563s7g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6clhmco31c9h2bs)
My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part.
I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation.
If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST.
**_[Please show your support today. I promise that President Trump& I will never stop fighting for YOU.>](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6terpegjup4fa31bst69n07g0dgseic6te0tckg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6clhmco31c9h2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zgfjk3tfis2vrsldqjj5eqp44cm5g9u4dkv46r20_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6clhmco31c9h2bs)
Thank you and may God bless you,
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmn5umv375phb2pm0lacr17seqjvh9ioi0hpjmto_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6clhmco31c9h2bs)

JD Vance Future Vice President of the United States
PS: If you can’t afford to donate because Kamala Harris has wrecked our economy, please save your donation for another time. I only ask that you please say a prayer for everyone currently serving in harm’s way.

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 8/13/2024
body:
Peters convicted on seven counts in election integrity trial
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks,
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, August 13, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Peters convicted on seven counts in election integrity trial](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Viewed as a patriot by many on the right concerned with election security and integrity, former Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters was convicted Monday on numerous counts related to a breakdown of her county’s election computer system in 2020.
Peters was convicted of three counts of attempting to influence a public servant, one count of conspiracy to commit criminal impersonation, first-degree official misconduct, violation of duty and failing to comply with the secretary of state.
Central to the case, Peters faced accusations she had used another person's security badge and her position to provide access to an expert related to MyPillow's Mike Lindell to the election system. Lindell also had questioned the validity of election results nationally.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In response to likely anti-gun Harris presidency and shooting of Trump, firearm sales jump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Gun sales increased for the first time in nearly a year following the assassination attempt on former President Donald Trump and the nomination of Vice President Kamala Harris as the Democratic presidential nominee, who has promised firearm restrictions.
* The nomination of Tim Walz, known for his strict stance on gun control, as Harris's running mate, further fueled the surge in gun sales.
* The National Shooting Sports Foundation reported that gun sales in July exceeded 1 million, continuing a five-year trend of high monthly sales, totaling over 86 million firearms sold in that period.
* Gun sellers and buyers, who initially did not anticipate significant political impact on sales this year, have reported increased customer fear for personal security and gun ownership rights due to the political climate.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘We’re going to get this seat back’: Bright vying to reclaim Senate District 13 for Republicans](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Scott Bright is campaigning to reclaim Colorado's Senate District 13 for the Republicans, a seat currently held by Democrat Kevin Priola after redistricting and previously by Republican John Cooke.
* Bright's campaign focuses on several key issues, including property tax relief, protecting the Taxpayer's Bill of Rights (TABOR), and enhancing school choice and teacher pay while removing politics from classrooms. He also prioritizes supporting the 2nd Amendment, safeguarding free speech, ending cashless bail, and addressing the criminalization of fentanyl.
* Bright is set to face Democrat Matt Johnston in the upcoming general election, emphasizing the importance of preventing a Democratic supermajority in the Colorado Legislature. He has received endorsements from several local mayors and the Weld County Sheriff, highlighting his commitment to representing the interests of families in Adams and Weld counties.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Dem’s VP hopeful Walz to attend fundraiser in Denver along five-stop, multi-state tour this week](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Minnesota Governor Tim Walz, recently named as Vice President Kamala Harris's running mate, is embarking on a cross-country fundraising tour that includes stops in California, Denver, Boston, Newport, and Southampton.
* Walz's campaign efforts highlight his strong union ties and worker-supportive policies, such as joining picket lines and passing significant pro-worker legislation in Minnesota.
* His tour comes shortly after Donald Trump's fundraiser in Aspen, with Trump criticizing the Harris campaign for similar strategies.
* This series of fundraisers marks Walz's first solo campaign effort since being announced as Harris's vice presidential pick.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Fact check: Incarcerated felons can’t vote, but upon release they can](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* In Colorado, individuals convicted of felonies can vote if they have completed their full sentence, including those on probation or parole.
* Those currently incarcerated or detained as part of their sentence are ineligible to vote but regain their voting rights upon release.
* Pretrial detainees and those out on bond awaiting trial are permitted to vote, with recent legislation mandating county clerks and sheriffs facilitate voting access in jails.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘Never’ Harris: Border Patrol agents on Kamala and that she is ‘probably worse than Biden’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Border Patrol agents interviewed by the Washington Examiner expressed a strong distrust of Democratic presidential nominee Kamala Harris, with none of the agents willing to vote for her due to perceived lack of support for their mission and organization.
* Agents criticized Harris for her approach as the unofficial "Border Czar," accusing her of failing to address the root causes of migration effectively and not engaging with agents directly. They fear her administration would worsen the security situation and continue what they see as failed policies from the Biden administration.
* Some agents are considering early retirement due to dissatisfaction with the current administration's handling of border security, citing increased arrests of migrants over national security threats like terrorism and drug trafficking. They believe a Harris presidency would exacerbate these issues.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Walz ‘did not earn the rank’ he claims, his unit successor Lt. Col. John Kolb says in Facebook post](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DAILY MAIL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Lieutenant Colonel John Kolb, who took over Tim Walz's former unit, criticized Walz for falsely claiming the rank of Command Sergeant Major and retiring just before his unit was deployed to Iraq.
* Kolb accused Walz of not genuinely earning his rank and stated that Walz's early retirement allowed for better leadership to emerge within the unit.
* The controversy over Walz's military service is being used in political attacks, complicating the Harris-Walz campaign as they face accusations of "stolen valor." High-profile figures and veterans have weighed in, questioning Walz's integrity and truthfulness regarding his service record.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Speaker Johnson: Only Americans should decide our elections. Here’s how Congress can guarantee it.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_There are few things more important to our country than ensuring the integrity of our elections. The people rightfully demand it, and Congress has a duty to act._
_Yet, when given the opportunity to eliminate one of the most glaring threats to fair elections, 198 House Democrats voted instead to keep the door open to fraud._
_The threat is very real. In nearly all 50 states today — including every major electoral battleground state — a noncitizen can walk into a DMV or welfare office, fill out a federal voter registration form, claim they are a U.S. citizen, and be registered to vote. That noncitizen can then cast a ballot and help decide the direction of America._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Vespa: Is Barack Obama covertly the QB of the Harris presidential campaign?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [TOWNHALL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Former House Speaker Kevin McCarthy isn’t one to spew conspiracy theories, but what he said about Kamala Harris’ campaign was interesting, given the recent hires._
_The California Republican said that the man who is the real campaign manager is none other than former President Barack Obama (via NY Post)._
_The former president worked behind the scenes to jettison Biden after his disastrous June 27 debate. He knew Biden couldn’t beat Trump and felt the same way about Kamala._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Devotional: Embracing red, white and true authenticity beyond politics](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | AUGUST 11** _As a pastor, I often face pressure to align with a political party. People want to know if I lean toward the red or blue party. My response is simple but meaningful: “I don’t align with red or blue, only with what is true!”_
**[Sloan: U.S. foreign affairs weakness was on display](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY KELLY SLOAN | COMMENTARY | AUGUST 11** _There were a couple bits of good news to emerge on the foreign affairs front this past week, of which highlight the atrophy of American strength, which is starting to become unmistakable._
**_[‘We’re not going anywhere’: Protect Kids Colorado pledges to be back in 2026 for another run at initiatives](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | AUGUST 10** _An effort to place two initiatives on the statewide 2024 ballot came up short, but leaders and volunteers of Protect Kids Colorado say they will continue the work toward successful 2026 signature campaigns._
**Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming an RMV Contributor. Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com?subject=Contributor%20Interest%20\(via%20Mountain%20Minute\))) or send us a message on social media to chat!
|
---
**🤔 DID YOU KNOW?** The shortest serving president in U.S. history, William Henry Harrison, delivered the **longest inaugural speech**. In 1841, Harrison spoke for a whopping 8,445 words during his inauguration speech, despite the cold and rainy weather. Unfortunately, he caught pneumonia and died just 32 days later.

subject: Kamala at the helm.

body:
Hundreds of questions must be answered over the next few months, and I’m asking for your input.

Friend,

So far, it appears that Democrats are enthusiastic about Kamala's candidacy. After all, they've sent her campaign more than $200 million in just over one week. But how long can the enthusiasm last with a far-left, radical progressive record like Kamala Harris??

Hundreds of questions must be answered over the next few months, and _**[I'm asking for your input.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6ep650n9hsdkoqv1ealkne89pv5fhj4vn0s8t80_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6clhm2p74c1h2bs)**_

**[Would you please answer ten brief questions right now? We'll use your responses to determine whether we need to recalibrate our campaign's overall direction.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zoqgq0nkqrqt5q5n3nl161dhmlkn8iprcpk9pgh8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6clhm2p74c1h2bs)**
**[<< BEGIN SENATE SURVEY >>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zajproqnrmvomechc3bmkt77pbbrmfntra0vfa4g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6clhm2p74c1h2bs)**
The dynamics of the forthcoming election have changed tremendously. Now that Democrats have ditched President Biden and elevated his vice president, Kamala Harris, does anyone know what's _**[really](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zfmp5b9mf9fa16dpqcmg2lsaejc3md9vnf44e13g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6clhm2p74c1h2bs)**_ going to happen in November?

Last month, we thought the die had been cast. President Biden was well on his way to a historic loss, and Kamala Harris was nowhere to be seen.

Then, everything changed in an instant. You know how it went. Barack Obama and Nancy Pelosi pushed Joe Biden to the curb to "save democracy" and anointed their preferred candidate, Kamala Harris, as the Democrats' new presidential nominee.

The choice the liberal party bosses made was interesting, to say the least, for several reasons:
* **Kamala Harris knew about Joe Biden 's mental decline and said NOTHING.**

* **Kamala Harris was complicit in the botched Afghanistan withdrawal -- she said so herself.**

* **Kamala Harris was rated the MOST liberal United States Senator during her tenure in the chamber. **

But one thing is clear as I write this email: We must end the radical Biden-Harris-Tester agenda.

Please do me a personal favor and fill out the brief questionnaire I've linked in this email.
For America's Future,

Are you worried about your financial stability in these unprecedented times? The **next two minutes** could profoundly impact your financial security.
Imagine waking up to find the economy has plunged. The national debt is soaring past $35 trillion, prompting the government to print more money, leading to skyrocketing inflation rates. Banks are in turmoil,**[holding your money hostage against your will](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=si5pjb&__onlt=h)**, while you wait for FDIC intervention. The real estate bubble has burst, and your portfolio has plummeted by 30% to 45%. Where would you turn?
To some, this may sound like fiction, but for those with money on the line, this is a stark reality. On Monday, August 5th, 2024, Americans awoke to both the **NASDAQ and DOW plummeting over 1,100 points each** , triggering a frenzy of selloffs.
History has shown us how a single event can trigger a market crash—like the dot-com bubble in 1999, the subprime mortgage crisis in 2008, and the pandemic in 2020. But today, we’re on the brink of something far more dangerous. We’re staring down multiple bubbles all at once: Real Estate, Stock Market, Bonds, and Banks. Compound that with relentless inflation, the threat of global recession, **[and the specter of wars](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=si5pjb&__onlt=h)** casting a shadow over the world, and you have the perfect storm. The consequences could be catastrophic, plunging us into a crisis unlike anything we’ve ever seen.

Despite 50 years of economic growth, recent events have laid bare the fragility of our financial systems. The quality of**life for most Americans has declined** , with wealth concentrated among the rich while the median American family’s income stagnates, creating a dangerously top-heavy social pyramid.
Moreover, hostile countries like Russia, China, and Iran are working to undermine the U.S. dollar as the world's reserve currency. If they succeed, it could lead to **higher borrowing costs, further inflation, and erosion of your wealth.**
Everyday Americans are now seeing the writing on the wall. They recognize that owning physical gold offers protection where other investments cannot. As global uncertainty increases, **[the value of gold](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=si5pjb&__onlt=h)** and silver as reliable, tangible assets becomes even more apparent.

Retaining your financial stability is crucial. You need investments that remain stable regardless of current events, government policies, or political leadership. **Gold is the "no matter what" store of wealth you need**.

In these turbulent times, owning gold and silver gives you control and a better outcome. Gold is more than just an investment; it’s a strategic move to protect your financial future and ensure stability for you and your family. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. The Objective...is to endure. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/7c80915256b1/n41kepo7ku-12707681?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=ebaad4985b&e=25844e23a8)
---
| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

**James 1:2-3** _Dear brothers and sisters, when troubles of any kind come your way, consider it an opportunity for great joy. For you know that when your faith is tested, your endurance has a chance to grow._

Endurance. I couldn't choose a better word to describe Nebraskans. We endure a LOT and it seems to be more every day. But endure doesn't mean something that is just forced upon you, it also implies a level of determination. A drive to survive and get to a better place after facing a struggle or challenge. Like anything, the more we endure, the more we gain confidence to carry on through struggles. This next 3 months will be one of the greatest tests of endurance for our party and our principles.

Can we push ourselves beyond limits to defend this country?

Specifically, can we push ourselves to see the value of local races like Board of Education, 244 school boards, NRD's, Power Boards, and engaging in leaders to be our next Legislative Representatives.

* * *

These coming weeks, I will endeavor to bring fruition to the 2024 Political and Legislative Vision and our ability for success in November. Over the last several "Coffee" emails, I've tried to convey the national presence we now have in the Republican Party of Nebraska. We have political creditability which is never more apparant by all the relationships we've built.

I've also tried to articulate our past so we don't repeat it and can MOVE FORWARD. I believe you can't show a new vision without context and truth. Truth hurts sometimes and can be painful to grow through.

Although some in our party may never come to this belief of my intentions, I will continually strive to build a bridge for all members to feel welcomed. Sometimes, though, people expect me to build a bridge for THEM to another person, or oddly, they expect me to kick the person OFF the bridge. I can only establish a vision and walk a path for me, not others.

I envision a bridge...with our [Constitution](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=d67f02cf04&e=25844e23a8) as the framework, our [Platform Values](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=970daeb341&e=25844e23a8) as the planks on which we stand, and the _**stability**_ is grounded in a firm foundation of our Faith in the Word. I am amazingly blessed by those who already stand on this bridge and even more so...the Party, the membership of this Party...the People, are blessed by the talents of so many like-minded servant leaders who volunteer their time.

We remember that the [NEGOP Constitution](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=ecd1d88aaa&e=25844e23a8) lays out that our membership is... Republicans _who desire to support the**objectives** of the Party_. The constitutional **objectives of our Party is the maintenance the government of, by, and for the people and to further our principles** (within the communities). I have found that our greatest challenge in finding __**stability**__ as a party was shifting a culture from being King-Makers to Difference-Makers. It's perceived that those who were here before us know better who will represent our principles. We have spent over a year understanding and communicating our [principles](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=256d8362a7&e=25844e23a8) so that the _Principles were FIRST, personalities were LAST_. Our second challenge is seeing the necessity to increase _**healthy conversations**_ around the implementation of the principles and NOT which one is of greatest priority.

It makes absolutely NO SENSE that the entire leadership of the party (from NEGOP elected leaders to elected officials) don't come TOGETHER and coordinate TOGETHER the implementation of our SHARED values.

We, the people, are on the outside looking in, waiting for the salvation of the government. That's NOT what we are called to be. We, the people, are the **watchers** and THE salvation of the state comes FROM us. Kinda fits along the lines with the OF, BY, and FOR message, right?

**What the HECK is holding us back?!?**

There is still the mentality that elected officials by VIRTUE of their positions KNOW better for the people and thus need little to no input from the communities they represent. Yet, someone, some entity, somewhere IS, in fact, INFLUENCING our elected officials.

And it ain't you...it's campaign money.

Donors. Lobbyists. Political war chests that dangle golden carrots making candidates believe that the only way to VICTORY every November is allegiance to their money. This in NEBRASKA, crazy... right?!? That's right, we have the same version of political manipulation as is nationally, it's just we are Nebraska Nice about it.

The suppression of the people at the county GOP and State GOP leadership positions was purposefully to ensure MONEY and the consultant machines thrived and the voters believed everything was under control.

Then July 9th, 2022 happened. We call it the true **Independence Day** for the Republican Party of Nebraska. Sure, it looked a little chaotic from the outside. It definitely WAS dysfunctional when we assumed control of the assets of the party because there was so LITTLE infrastructure internally. The amount of conversations I've had at the national level indicating that the messaging out of Nebraska was "We don't need to grow or build or need assistance, we got this!" From the context of comparing to other state parties, we were less than one election cycle away from implosion simply because we lacked the same political infrastructure of communications, data, digital, and finance.

But over the last two years we made a concerted effort to endure. To persist. To learn and grow and build and seek assistance from many.

Stability has been the result. Stability you created by ENDURING.

Make no mistake though...the culture has not fully flipped. There are still those in our party whose only expectations of a State or County GOP is to show blind allegiance to politicians. They spend senseless amount of time begging the party and leaders to prove this allegiance. This culture is almost a psychosis of needed affirmation and approval, a "two thumbs up or gold star" desire for a political identity.

This vanity, envy, pride, ego, false idol...as you can image...almost destroyed us

Yes, there is a need for money in campaigns, but the average voter is not looking for a mailed, texted, phone call relationship with their representatives. They are BEGGING for something more real. A genuine leader to meet them at the door and EARN the vote through time and effort. We need to CONNECT to the voters because our principles resonate with a vast majority of Nebraskans, but the candidate and party has to make the effort to connect. We need campaign money to build the infrastructure and resource to connect to voters...we do not NEED to be BUYING elections. Big difference.

Political personalities are impacting our effectiveness and our Values suffer (along with the good people of Nebraska who have entrusted leaders by ELECTING them). We RARELY examine, discuss, communicate and promote the EXACT values of the party. What EXACTLY is the WRITTEN and DOCUMENTED [Platform Value](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=2cecd468e7&e=25844e23a8) that we disagree on?

This is where the people of the Party have to make their stand. If we (and I mean ALL, when I say WE) don't have a collective conversation about our principles, articulate them passionately but with a common sense context...then our **opposition** will control that narrative. **It's time to be an unapologetic REPUBLICAN!** It's time to be an educated and proactive _[Constitutional](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=4a53d6f567&e=25844e23a8) and [Platform](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=a5da0e6e48&e=25844e23a8) Republican_ (CPR). As a CPR, you will breathe life into our message and the voters will believe again in the party as a WHOLE.

Yes, we at some point have to become WHOLE again. Built on a stable foundation of strong county parties **(which we have)** creating engagement opportunities **(which we do)** for Values and CPR's to connect to the local constituents. The best avenue for communication is the county events, gatherings, meetings, fundraisers and most importantly and EFFECTIVELY at the door of the Nebraska voter. Because then the connection with the Voter revolves around THEM and THEIR needs and not us PROJECTING onto them a palm card worth of potentially unfulfilled political promises.

We represent the Nebraska 'Good Life'.
We represent life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.
We represent the light of Christ which is what the hurting need now.

The NEGOP has achievable goals to connect our [Values](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=5b8db6379a&e=25844e23a8) to Voters. The **2024 Voter Involvement Plan** is a program designed to engage and involve Republican voters with our CPR candidates. Not all areas will be accomplished and some have a greater level of impact...but we have to endure. **This takes ALL of us to make it achievable!**
Whatever you do...DON'T wait for someone else. You are who God is calling to make a difference.

[900 DEMOCRATS](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=bf8e46acc6&e=25844e23a8) are controlling your school systems, your taxing authorities, your electric boards, your higher education like UNL and Community Colleges...these LOCAL races are WINNABLE by YOU! You can no longer wait for legislation or federal TO change your local politics.

Local changes LOCAL [](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=716b402520&e=25844e23a8)
It's time to get off the couch, off the computer, off the recliner.

You HAVE to knock on a door to save your country.
You HAVE to write a letter of introduction, or thank you, or invite for a candidate to save your country.
You HAVE to give our local Republican candidates $10 more dollars so they can print more signs, or handouts, and buy more stamps to save YOUR country.
You HAVE to help us find EVERY Republican who gets an early ballot and remind them to VOTE! We will call them, text them, mail them, and even stop by to shake their hand...**but we will leave no Republican behind**....

IF...

If you choose to endure.

The truth shall set us free.

With much blessings,
---
|

| –Chairman Underwood

And that’s why I’m doing all I can to help Jacky win her race in Nevada. She's fought to create good-paying jobs, protect reproductive freedom, and defend American democracy itself. But here's the nastier side of politics: With our Democratic Senate majority riding on Jacky's race, dark money groups and super PACs aligned with Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell are pouring millions of dollars into defeating her. = I know you're likely nervous about the outcome of things come November. I am, too. We're reading the same headlines. Worrisome polls, unthinkable Supreme Court decisions, and our fundamental freedoms and democratic norms in the cross-hairs. Unfortunately, with the Supreme Court's recent ruling on presidential immunity – effectively putting presidents above the law – Donald Trump could take his worst impulses even further if reelected. Our future depends on the Senate, and the Senate depends on what happens in battleground Nevada this year. Each one of us has to do all we can to help Jacky win, so I'm personally counting on you. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. Hi, friend, it’s Sherrod here. In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[chip in just $5.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90728022/491474107/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk2491-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOTc2YTNiYi03NjU5LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vzOFVxQTixJ64u4YeWmMkjWsOeiMF9h8UrsZG6ktFIA=)** But before I do, I want to make sure you understand who you’re supporting, what we're up against, and why your $5 donation couldn’t be more important.
I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio, a small town full of good, hardworking people: ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, teachers, and electricians. My parents taught me, above all, to be kind and to give back when I could. And that's what I'm doing today.
That means fighting in the Senate to raise the minimum wage, protect Social Security and Medicare, and hold big banks and corporations accountable for the damage they've done to workers and our economy. It means standing up for voting rights, reproductive rights, marriage equality, and more.
I’m fighting for Ohioans and the Dignity of Work because I want what most Americans want: to ensure our nation delivers on its promises. But right now, I need your help.
**Recent polls show me neck and neck with my Trump-backed opponent, and experts say Ohio** _will_** decide Senate control. The only way I can defend my seat and keep up our progress is with your critical support,** **which is why I have to ask, friend:_[Will you chip in $5 or more now to keep Ohio and the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90728023/491474114/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk2491-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOTc2YTNiYi03NjU5LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vzOFVxQTixJ64u4YeWmMkjWsOeiMF9h8UrsZG6ktFIA=)_**
Without a doubt, this is my _toughest_ reelection yet. With multiple experts calling me one of the most vulnerable senators in the _entire_ country, Mitch McConnell has _personally_ named me a top target for defeat.

Now, Trump, McConnell, and their MAGA megadonors are spending record-breaking amounts in Ohio to try to defeat me and flip the Senate red. That's why this race is on track to be one of the most competitive and expensive in the country.

# Carmela Advances to the General Election!
---
| We did it! Together, we made it into the top two and now have a chance to change the direction in WA-05!
As a third-generation Eastern Washingtonian from a blue-collar family, I’m honored to have the chance to represent our community in the general election.
Since we launched our campaign, I’ve been overwhelmed by your support – from our thousands of grassroots donors to the hundreds of volunteers who knocked on doors and called on their neighbors to get out the vote.
Together, we’ve shown just how strong our people-powered campaign is – and that we’re ready to bring real representation back to Eastern Washington.
The next 84 days - twelve weeks - won’t be easy – we now face an extremely competitive race against a far-right, anti-abortion, anti-Affordable Health Care, and anti-labor opponent.
I’m running to represent WA-05 to stand up to the exact type of partisan extremism that my opponent represents.
Instead of adding to the dysfunction in Congress, I will bring my experience in advocacy, security, and law, to work with anyone who is serious about solving problems for Eastern Washington.
The race to the General Election has begun, and we must do everything in our power to win this seat, end the MAGA clown show in Congress, and deliver real change for hard-working Eastern Washingtonians.
I am ready for this final push to November – Are you with me?
Thank you for your support. Together we can do this.
_\- Carmela_

name: Matt Diemer
subject: They are weird
body:
| |
---
Peter, I agree with Vice Presidential Candidate Tim Walz: the other guys are weird. Take my opponent, Max Miller, for example. This is a guy who decided to hold his wedding at Donald Trump’s golf course — a decision that tells you everything you need to know about where his loyalties lie. But the weirdness doesn’t stop there. He’s part of a party that seems more interested in bizarre culture wars than in actually helping the people they represent. Just look at what Republicans are up to lately. They’re obsessed with controlling what LGBTQ+ people do in their private lives as if that’s somehow a priority for our country. They’re pushing absurd laws that punish people who don’t have biological children, as if families that don’t fit their narrow definition aren’t real families at all. | Peter,

We're facing more grave injustice and we're fighting back.

Last week, the Center for Reproductive Rights filed federal complaints against two Texas hospitals on behalf of two women who were denied life-saving treatment for ectopic pregnancies. This continues our work on behalf of patients denied or delayed critical abortion care despite dangerous pregnancy complications.

Nationwide, ectopic pregnancy—in which a fertilized egg implants in a location other than inside the uterus—is **the leading cause of maternal mortality in the first trimester, accounting for up to 10% of all pregnancy-related deaths.**

[**Here's what you need to know:**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90732541/491486316/661812231?sourceid=1149733&utm_campaign=25emaab-0802aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=arf&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZDQ4MjE1Ni03YzU5LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9LFeRXUiu1vN8DQPaXBPhendhVGGPoygxpkUEqfn9Tw=&emci=8831915e-f158-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=8d482156-7c59-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=954237)
* Texas hospitals are turning away patients in desperate need of emergency care for life-threatening ectopic pregnancies.
* The Center has filed formal complaints against two of these hospitals with the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
* These complaints charge the hospitals with violating EMTALA, the federal law that mandates emergency treatment.

This is an urgent crisis. **Denying critical care in these dire circumstances isn't just unlawful—it threatens patients’ health, fertility, and possibly their lives.** | [**LEARN MORE**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/90732542/491486319/661812231?sourceid=1149733&utm_campaign=25emaab-0802aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=arf&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZDQ4MjE1Ni03YzU5LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9LFeRXUiu1vN8DQPaXBPhendhVGGPoygxpkUEqfn9Tw=&emci=8831915e-f158-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=8d482156-7c59-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=954237 "LEARN MORE")

# [Demand Trump stop lying about his helicopter crash story](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tff67e3fb-26d5-4531-959b-84ccc76521ae/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5310866f-5b70-4ccb-a795-3eb893f6e4f9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | Donald Trump has repeatedly told a story of a frighteningly [rough](https://default.salsalabs.org/T532760f4-eeac-4d3f-afdf-c81e23771636/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) helicopter landing on a ride with (then) San Francisco mayor Willie Brown. And how in the midst of the terror over whether they might crash, Brown told him terrible things about Kamala Harris. There's just one problem -- [Brown says he has no idea what the hell Trump is talking about](https://default.salsalabs.org/T78e3513f-0d71-4ce8-9a08-7ca53b1edd02/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). He's never even been on a helicopter with Trump, let alone one that almost crashed. And given that Brown was mayor, and one of the most famous and quoted leaders in all of California, how in the world would this have happened with zero media coverage? It's a total fabrication, meant to make Trump look tough and Harris look bad. And Trump has been told that it's BS. And yet, Trump STILL is repeating it. [**Please join us in demanding Trump stop telling the story, and that the media call it out for being total BS.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7791393a-ee0b-4425-a723-dc7616271506/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:
It was my experience in the Navy that helped instill in me the importance of service.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=15d07f4d47c540c39f6dd59a18f66580&_e=Q71vnQG-eKBHlEkbf60QyDqG8sVAPmOm5SM6qq6dAu8ccDl1qsdNDgf5ykS-ya-s_YdIQJnN0AJrLpZEu4Ze-ef4Ueum72Dk7XTw1NTQXFF-BAexKvjB6rL-52ELFrDTEO2VoY4B37_2-diJv-zSVPQvAU50Li0iND0BptUvItATOWV4BFx4Ape-ggkNa2uAYggLP6ADT70LaZ-fKJUKiVFVKAxztByNrWItBdhGUKq1MFnpw2BIX9TRErGyqCc0HNKZwyHIZSMF7t8f3ZGTr64dy5fs1iUFThB2nIsqNMJYGM5SXTNI0mOzzXe0T0SHNidyqN1ph_JEeaGz2ZGqt0BR52NZ3pF7V9F2hokLtOM04M6hEo4A3mf52DeIBoWlUIVZRpPBoBo8Y1V0GYVZtMz0YXCQFlmNtf2bPahxRLv5pzygRCHag3wzVL5xYUjW)
---

That's a picture of me from when I flew H-46 and H-3 helicopters in the U.S. Navy. If you look to my left, you can see my call sign...**Blossom**.

People often ask...how did I get that name?

Well, my roommate in flight school and I went on a bit of a "girl power" kick one day and bought old bathtub non-skid flower stickers from the store, cut out that flower shape in reflective tape from our squadron, and stuck those reflective flowers on our helmets.

There is very little room for making a Navy flight suit more "feminine," but on cruise we were able to be a little more creative and came to love those girly flowers on our helmets.

Although the helicopter community doesn't use call signs as much as some of the fixed wing squadrons, the "Blossom" stuck and was painted on the side of a CH-46 for part of my first cruise. Made for a great photo and story!

It was my experience in the Navy that helped instill in me the importance of service.

Far too often, our elected officials today forget that their job is to SERVE. They think it is their job to tell everyone what to do and why everyone else is wrong....but that's not service.

As a Navy veteran and nurse practitioner, I got so frustrated and decided to run for Congress because I wanted to actually SERVE my country and my community.

**While for some it is all about power, for me it is all about _service_.**

Sadly, this has made me some enemies in Washington. After I pulled off a historic victory in 2022 and helped flip the House from Democrat to Republican control, I've had a target on my back...

Democrats have made me their #1 target because they know I won't just go along with the party line. No one is going to buy me off or tell me what to do...I'm going to keep serving the people I represent, not serve some "master" in Washington, D.C.

If you are also tired of leaders who care more about power than service, **[I'm asking you to send me some help today.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=15d07f4d47c540c39f6dd59a18f66580&_e=Q71vnQG-eKBHlEkbf60QyDqG8sVAPmOm5SM6qq6dAu8ccDl1qsdNDgf5ykS-ya-s_YdIQJnN0AJrLpZEu4Ze-ef4Ueum72Dk7XTw1NTQXFF-BAexKvjB6rL-52ELFrDTEO2VoY4B37_2-diJv-zSVPQvAU50Li0iND0BptUvItATOWV4BFx4Ape-ggkNa2uAYggLP6ADT70LaZ-fKJUKiVFVKAxztByNrWItBdhGUKq1MFnpw2BIX9TRErGyqCc0HNKZwyHIZSMF7t8f3ZGTr64dy5fs1iUFThB2nIsqNMI4wUMbiN2Ij5ivF9kUWhE-A6iIH5rtzbXx-HSszcecGOvoO9O426pRdqHNk5kmLVrvBcuRPYw1zeUVDfB_vrwlEWqsEJlhTH2C42TwV3SinkLIaVQrZdkk7Yr8BMyJdO8wjyqDfXLlW3HDamsEOM-2 "I’m asking you to send me some help today. ")**

Because I'm a veteran and not a career politician, I need all the help I can get to defeat my Democrat opponent. Democrats are already spending BIG on ads and billboards attacking me, so it is critical our campaign has the resources to FIGHT back.

---

It's time we support leaders who truly want to serve our country, and that's what I promise to always do...are you with me, Friend?

clean_body: It was my experience in the Navy that helped instill in me the importance of service. | | | | | | That's a picture of me from when I flew H-46 and H-3 helicopters in the U.S. Navy. If you look to my left, you can see my call sign...Blossom. People often ask...how did I get that name? Well, my roommate in flight school and I went on a bit of a "girl power" kick one day and bought old bathtub non-skid flower stickers from the store, cut out that flower shape in reflective tape from our squadron, and stuck those reflective flowers on our helmets. There is very little room for making a Navy flight suit more "feminine," but on cruise we were able to be a little more creative and came to love those girly flowers on our helmets. Although the helicopter community doesn't use call signs as much as some of the fixed wing squadrons, the "Blossom" stuck and was painted on the side of a CH-46 for part of my first cruise. Made for a great photo and story! It was my experience in the Navy that helped instill in me the importance of service. Far too often, our elected officials today forget that their job is to SERVE. They think it is their job to tell everyone what to do and why everyone else is wrong....but that's not service. As a Navy veteran and nurse practitioner, I got so frustrated and decided to run for Congress because I wanted to actually SERVE my country and my community. While for some it is all about power, for me it is all about service. Sadly, this has made me some enemies in Washington. After I pulled off a historic victory in 2022 and helped flip the House from Democrat to Republican control, I've had a target on my back... Democrats have made me their #1 target because they know I won't just go along with the party line. There's a U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year that I think you need to know about.
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66436?refcode=em20240813-7330&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7330%2E614464%2El2pHaO)
Hey Peter, it’s Jon Hamm.
**There’s an important U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year that I think you need to know about.**
So before I ask you to chip in toward my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to defeat Josh Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, please let me explain why no one can afford to sit on the sidelines in this race.
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66436?refcode=em20240813-7330&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7330%2E614464%2El2pHaO)**
Let’s start at the beginning. When I first got to know Lucas, his story resonated with me. He’s a born-and-raised Missourian who knows the real value of community — helping each other out, for better or for worse.
Growing up, his parents went bankrupt from his youngest sister’s medical bills and his family survived on the support of their friends and neighbors. After getting to college on a Pell Grant, Lucas decided to join the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given his family so much. He served for 13 years, including three deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan before later being stationed at the Pentagon.
Once he left active duty, Lucas turned his focus to the corrupt politicians and corporate monopolies that dominate our economy and squeeze small businesses. He took on everyone from Big Tech and Big Ag to defense contractors and pharmaceutical companies.
**Now, Lucas is running to defeat January 6th coward Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat for real, everyday people.**
**[ELECT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66436?refcode=em20240813-7330&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7330%2E614464%2El2pHaO)**
Let’s just be clear here: Hawley’s January 6th cowardice isn’t the only reason he’s incapable of representing my home state.
**Since he was elected to office, Josh Hawley hasn’t fought to bring even $0.01 back to our communities — but he’s had plenty of time to make money for himself.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66436?refcode=em20240813-7330&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7330%2E614464%2El2pHaO)
While giant corporations strip our state of opportunity and jack up prices, Hawley is only focused on enriching himself. He’s made hundreds of thousands of dollars more than his congressional salary by selling his weird book all about _"Manhood."_
**All this, while he made taxpayers cover the cost of his own lawbreaking.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66436?refcode=em20240813-7330&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7330%2E614464%2El2pHaO)
Missouri can’t afford another six years of Hawley in the Senate, Peter, and voters of all stripes seem to agree.
**_Morning Consult_ reported that Josh Hawley has the lowest approval rating of any Republican incumbent up for re-election this November.** And even Hawley’s own former mentor, Missouri’s three-term Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth, said supporting Hawley was _“the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.”_
After spending a whole year consolidating support from workers, community leaders, and organizations across Missouri, Lucas Kunce has more than proved that he has what it takes to win this race. Multiple polls even confirm he’s in a dead heat with Hawley. That’s why I’m asking for your help, Peter:
**[Will you join me in supporting my friend Lucas Kunce by chipping in $10 or more today? With so much at stake in this election — and with a race this close — no one can afford to sit on the sidelines.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66436?refcode=em20240813-7330&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7330%2E614464%2El2pHaO)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66437?refcode=em20240813-7330&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=7&akid=7330%2E614464%2El2pHaO) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66437?refcode=em20240813-7330&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=8&akid=7330%2E614464%2El2pHaO) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66436?refcode=em20240813-7330&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=7330%2E614464%2El2pHaO)
---
Lucas won’t be another shady, corrupt politician. He’s put his money where his mouth is since day one — refusing to accept any money from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or Big Oil and Big Pharma executives.
**He’s running to be a real warrior for working Missourians, unbeholden to anyone other than the everyday people who elected him to office.**
Lucas will fight for investment in our state — rebuilding forgotten communities, creating jobs, and empowering workers. He’ll stand up to the attacks on reproductive rights by controlling politicians like Hawley. He’ll work to end the corporate grip on power in our country, by banning insider trading and abolishing corporate PACs. And he’ll be accountable to real, everyday Missourians.
I can’t tell you how excited I am about everything we’ll be able to accomplish in Missouri with Lucas fighting for us in the Senate, Peter. But if we’re going to take advantage of this historic opportunity, Lucas urgently needs your help.
