body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1769%2E135344%2ESYxN7y)

Friend -
If you were waiting for the perfect time to make your first donation to my campaign for Senate, not only is today the perfect day but there's also a very good reason as well.
Betsy DeVos.
If you're already familiar with her significant support for my opponent and are ready to chip in, please use this link to give:
**[https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/beat-devos](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240813-1-900&t=2&akid=1769%2E135344%2ESYxN7y)**
Otherwise, let me go a little deeper ... including a very recent revelation about her designs on a role in a second Trump administration.
As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education, and one of his longest serving cabinet secretaries.
Much like our Republican opponent, Mike Rogers, she condemned Donald Trump after January 6, 2021. In Betsy DeVos’ case, she “resigned in protest” as Education Secretary, blaming his rhetoric on the insurrection -- just 13 days before the end of Trump’s term.
And like my current opponent who turned around and worked hard for Trump's endorsement, Betsy DeVos is now back -- and willing to serve in a second Trump administration.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240813-1-900&t=3&akid=1769%2E135344%2ESYxN7y)
So what does that mean?
As if there weren't already a million reasons to defeat Donald Trump, there's now one more: keeping Betsy DeVos out of any role of prominence in Washington, D.C.
And there is no doing that without winning in Michigan.
The DeVos family has been some of the top supporters to opponents of mine in the past, and they've doubled down on this Senate race.
Mike Rogers' first FEC report in this race was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family -- contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day. And just last week, Betsy DeVos herself was campaigning with Mike Rogers at a roundtable just a day before the primary election.
They are certainly not done with their support of my opponent.
On a positive note, the response to emails about the DeVos donations has raised far more than the DeVos family has contributed. But we have to keep going, because their family's unlimited wealth can impact this race in many more ways.
So in light of this news about Betsy DeVos' potential return to Washington, D.C. and her role in campaigning for my opponent, I am asking:
[**Can you contribute $3 directly to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan? I will put your donation made today in Betsy’s name right to work persuading the voters we need to win in Michigan this fall.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240813-1-900&t=4&akid=1769%2E135344%2ESYxN7y)

| Peter,

One November 5th, voters like you will have the opportunity to vote on Measure 4, a ballot initiative that will eliminate North Dakota’s property tax and fundamentally change the way local funding is handled in our state.

**This measure provides much-needed reform and relief to North Dakota property owners.**

Measure 4 will change the method of local funding, replacing the current system of unfair valuations and confusing mill levies with a more transparent and fair approach.

**This will give local communities full control over their own funding decisions** , ensuring that they can raise the resources they need without relying on property taxes.
---
[](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=f03216ef7f&e=d842fb25cc)

| **Under Measure 4, the state will replace what you are currently paying in property tax every year.** This means that you will only pay for future increased local needs, as determined locally.

The state has the financial resources to easily replace the $1 billion in property taxes annually without raising taxes or cutting services.

**Here's how we can do it:**

✅ $200 million from the Legacy Fund interest
✅ $600 million in excess revenue over forecast
✅ $200 million in savings from reducing spending on corporate welfare and special interest payouts

This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to end the unfair burden of property taxes on North Dakota families and businesses. But we need your help to make it happen.

| Good morning Friend,

name: Shelby County Republican Party
subject: Shelby County Republican Party News (August 12, 2024)
body:
Hello Shelby County Patriots,

The biggest news at the moment is our Meet the Candidates Night on September 3rd. This has the potential to fill to capacity quickly, and we may need to cut off reservations at some point. So, if you plan to come, RSVP quickly. When you do, you will be sent more detailed information about the flow of the evening.

Additionally, here is the latest info on our next three meetings and other important events.

All Republican Party meetings start at 6:00 PM and are held at Calvary United Baptist Church, 9480 County Rd 25A, Sidney, Oh 45365.

Tuesday, August 20, 2024
Garrett Arnold, the State Director of Ohio for the Trump campaign is expected to be there.

Tuesday, September 17, 2024
Joshua Lisec; Co-Author with Jack Posobiec, of "_Unhumans: The Secret History of Communist Revolutions (and How to Crush Them)_ “ is our expected speaker.

Tuesday, October 15, 2024
We’re still working on the program for this one.

Other events on the horizon:

Lake Loramie Trump Flotilla; Saturday, August 31, 2024.

Every Saturday Morning from Sep 7 until election day, we will have a tent set up on the town square in Sidney (during the Farmer’s Market) passing out signs and literature from 8:00 AM to Noon. We set up on a vacant lot with lots of space across the street from the market.

Cheers...Dan Cecil, Chairman
(937) 206-2970
[cecilda.usaf@gmail.com](mailto:cecilda.usaf@gmail.com)

# **August 13th Newsletter**

---
Dear neighbors,
---
| | After three days of heavy wind gusts and persistent rain, I want to express my gratitude and appreciation for the preparedness and quick response of our local and state first responders. Thanks to their efforts, the 25th District managed to fare well and experienced minimal long-term effects due to Tropical Storm Debby. As noted in the special edition newsletter regarding the tropical storm, I encourage all who have not already done so to create an emergency kit for future weather events. There is no time like the present to do so. For inspiration, visit the [Prince William County Office of Emergency Management website](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90743136/491517520/1867209643?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZGUyMTIxNS04ZDU5LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0e7y8M04Jl8Q7cDSTDhWQZwYzJwijMN8EwNC_ccVqlg=&emci=fd3c836b-f158-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=5de21215-8d59-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=21796801). I have also included the contact information for various agencies below. Be sure to program these numbers into your phone and keep a hard copy in a safe space in case of an emergency. As you continue to read this newsletter, you will find information regarding pictures from National Night Out, a summary of my recent visit to KinderCare's Woodbridge location, a list of upcoming events to include our first bill workshop in preparation for the 2025 Virginia General Assembly Session, and links to noteworthy news articles.

# **National Night Out**
---
| | Thanks to the residents of Westminster at Lake Ridge, the Town of Occoquan, and Prince William County Center Owners Association for hosting the Prince William County Police Department, Occoquan Police Department, Chairwoman Deshundra Jefferson, Supervisor Kenny Boddye, Chairwoman, and me for National Night Out.
---
National Night Out is held on the first Tuesday of August. The annual event serves as local police and residents to come together in an effort to make neighborhoods safer, more caring places to live while breaking bread, participating in games, and activities with the goal of enhancing the relationship between neighbors and law enforcement.

---
| | Recently, I had the chance to tour KinderCare’s Woodbridge location for an enlightening tour of their facility. I am working diligently to increase childcare access and affordability while expanding early childhood education programs to ensure all children have a solid foundation for future success.

Peter,

In times like these, we need leaders who have truly answered the call to serve. **As someone born and raised in Stockton in a proud military family, I didn’t just talk about service – _I lived it._**

I joined the Marine Corps in 2001, trained at the military police academy, and was honored to be recruited by the White House to serve on Marine One, directly supporting the President of the United States amidst some of the most challenging times in our nation's history.

_**My commitment to this nation goes beyond words – I’ve walked the walk, defending the very freedoms we hold dear.**_ My service was genuine and unwavering – something we can’t say for everyone in politics today.

_**Enough is enough.**_

I’m running for Congress in California’s 9th District, and we can’t afford to lose this seat to the Democrats in November. The stakes are too high, and the radical left is too dangerous. | **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

Hello,
When my husband Adam Frisch ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, we were the underdogs until the very end.
Adam did not receive any national support. We were heavily out-raised and out-spent by Boebert and her Washington allies.
Ultimately, though, Adam lost in a recount by just 546 votes – the closest race in the entire country.
The worst part is that it wasn’t because we didn’t work hard. Our family, our team, and our volunteers gave it everything we had. We just ran out of money.
In the final weeks of the race, we had to cut back. Right as Boebert was increasing her advertising – right as we _knew_ we were on her heels – we had to pull TV ads, cancel digital buys, and make a lot of hard budget decisions.
Adam might not say it, but I will: If we had had additional resources and been able to fully fund his campaign until the end, Adam would probably be in Congress right now – and Lauren Boebert would be a footnote in a history book.
It’s part of why Adam announced so early that he was running again. We need to make sure that we have the money to build a campaign that can sustain all the way through to November 5, 2024.
But with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this race is a lot harder. The Super PACs are already attacking Adam, and he’s not taking any money from corporate PACs. If he is going to win this critical House seat, Adam needs grassroots donors like you to chip in right now:

clean_body: Adam might not say it, but I will. Hello, When my husband Adam Frisch ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, we were the underdogs until the very end. Adam did not receive any national support. We were heavily out-raised and out-spent by Boebert and her Washington allies. Ultimately, though, Adam lost in a recount by just 546 votes – the closest race in the entire country. The worst part is that it wasn’t because we didn’t work hard. Our family, our team, and our volunteers gave it everything we had. We just ran out of money. In the final weeks of the race, we had to cut back. Right as Boebert was increasing her advertising – right as we knew we were on her heels – we had to pull TV ads, cancel digital buys, and make a lot of hard budget decisions. Adam might not say it, but I will: If we had had additional resources and been able to fully fund his campaign until the end, Adam would probably be in Congress right now – and Lauren Boebert would be a footnote in a history book. It’s part of why Adam announced so early that he was running again. We need to make sure that we have the money to build a campaign that can sustain all the way through to November 5, 2024. But with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this race is a lot harder. The Super PACs are already attacking Adam, and he’s not taking any money from corporate PACs. If he is going to win this critical House seat, Adam needs grassroots donors like you to chip in right now: = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = From our entire family, thank you. Tuesday, August 13, 2024 | Peter -- It's a big week for the Pennsylvania Forward Party. Just a couple days ago, our friends in Pennsylvania [**secured ballot access for two statewide candidates for office**](https://www.forwardparty.com/media/2024/08/09/pennsylvania-forward-party-statewide-ticket-achieves-ballot-access-launches-general-election-campaigns/?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_47&n=2). Eric Settle is running for Attorney General, and Chris Foster is running for Treasurer. These two offices should be held by people who are independent and not beholden to partisan interests, and the Forward Party is giving Pennsylvanians such options. **Eric Settle** , a lawyer and former Republican, is running for attorney general to bring a fresh perspective to the office. The attorney general is a state's chief law enforcement officer, and they should be applying the law equally and fairly. A job that requires devotion to the law over any political connection is one that should be filled by a candidate who isn't captured by the partisan establishment. **Chris Foster** , an entrepreneur and former Democrat, is running to bring an independent perspective to state treasurer. He's dedicated to making the treasurer's office more transparent and taking a pragmatic approach to managing the state's finances. The two legacy parties have operated too long without an independent eye ensuring they are spending the people's money responsibly and without corruption. The Pennsylvania Forward Party is bringing real choice to the Keystone state. No more choosing between the lesser of two evils. It's time for real choices, and better choices. It's time to #MoveForward.

Chris Foster , an entrepreneur and former Democrat, is running to bring an independent perspective to state treasurer. I want to be honest: [**If you’re able to make a contribution of $5 or anything you can right now to support our re-election campaign, it would be a huge help.](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-warren-split.-45zWj&refcode=em240813-1-c&t=1&akid=5369%2E196590%2E7PYgED)**
Right now we’re tracking behind our August fundraising target. If we fall short of any of our grassroots fundraising goals this year, it could have implications for our campaign.
A new right-wing Super PAC launched to target me and boost one of my GOP opponents. It’s got ties to the Trump administration, Mitch McConnell, and powerful corporate interests — from Big Oil to Big Pharma to the big banks.
Our grassroots movement is fighting to hold these special interests accountable — and the fact is that we need to be able to compete with their spending. This campaign is supported by grassroots donors chipping in $5 at a time, not wealthy outside funders.
[**So, will you please pitch in $5 or anything you can right now to ensure our grassroots fundraising efforts can remain competitive?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-warren-split.-45zWj&refcode=em240813-1-c&t=2&akid=5369%2E196590%2E7PYgED)

When you make a donation to support this campaign, you’re not just ensuring I can keep up the fight for working families in the Senate. This isn’t about me, it’s about the policies we’re fighting for, and the people who those policies benefit.

Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=29b8cb0c2146408db5010fe8e4e0951b&_e=Z_fH-Dt4PkO3h9PftPxX0FZruZwe3q3bv0Ff_vCcKI8NEpLz4TIO3-r3UFeAauxnnOEy3SIEQEKH7Z7E5AWK4a9BAPZz28oP3J0n5ckD5BcRlzFIkvZUkUhMnMis4mYx778kUtn1OVH68QMY0Y_KUI1kNIeXeeKHelgVFdYrqzpdjX-GaMnq5ksCJzs7_ZFRQup--kI-YL4gC9PbN-eQNZC7s8jhohECYmVL1sJZwC541aNN057b7NhdYgAa5NvZ0_Tf3Rxw18XGZuzrnXTwSFgxz2MqbSFvU9LuS6rJ2Ju82bBUr2UhxjUb9bt8FPqq)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. name: Ilhan Omar
subject: Today
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
If you were to ask me what the _worst_ part about running for Congress is, I'd say that the truth is **I hate how much money there is poisoning our political system.**
I hate how super PACs and anonymous billionaires can spend unlimited amounts to influence our elections. I hate how many of my colleagues in Congress take no issue with our broken, corrupt system because it all serves to benefit them.
But I also understand that **in order for our movement to win** , we need the resources required to stay competitive. We have to run TV ads, we have to open offices, we have to fund our organizing efforts on the ground, and so much more.
**But all that doesn't mean that we can't stick true to our values.**
We've proven time and time again that running a winning campaign through small-dollar, grassroots contributions is not only possible, it's an incredibly powerful way to demonstrate our movement's strength.
So I'm really hoping that you can make your first contribution to stand with me before then. **What do you say?**
[Will you split a $5 contribution between Alexandria and I today? Both of our campaigns are powered by lots and lots of people chipping in small amounts at a time, so every dollar makes a huge difference.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240813-ilhan.uWZfAq&refcode=em20240813-6994-P_FND_SPL_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6994%2E2526796%2EUpW1TL)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240813-ilhan.uWZfAq&refcode=em20240813-6994-P_FND_SPL_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=6994%2E2526796%2EUpW1TL)**
Your grassroots support — a huge portion of it coming directly from emails like this one — is what allows us to fund our campaign this way.
It's what allows me to spend my time, energy, and focus fighting for policies that benefit working people, supporting my constituents in Minnesota, and building our progressive movement **all across the country.**
I don't take that for granted. I never have, and I never will.
Thanks for everything.
In solidarity,
Ilhan

clean_body: If you were to ask me what the worst part about running for Congress is, I'd say that the truth is I hate how much money there is poisoning our political system. I hate how super PACs and anonymous billionaires can spend unlimited amounts to influence our elections. I hate how many of my colleagues in Congress take no issue with our broken, corrupt system because it all serves to benefit them. But I also understand that in order for our movement to win , we need the resources required to stay competitive. We have to run TV ads, we have to open offices, we have to fund our organizing efforts on the ground, and so much more. But all that doesn't mean that we can't stick true to our values. We've proven time and time again that running a winning campaign through small-dollar, grassroots contributions is not only possible, it's an incredibly powerful way to demonstrate our movement's strength. So I'm really hoping that you can make your first contribution to stand with me before then. What do you say? Your grassroots support — a huge portion of it coming directly from emails like this one — is what allows us to fund our campaign this way. It's what allows me to spend my time, energy, and focus fighting for policies that benefit working people, supporting my constituents in Minnesota, and building our progressive movement all across the country. I don't take that for granted. I never have, and I never will. Thanks for everything. In solidarity, Ilhan | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

| Each year, it seems like schools are inching further and further toward the “Whole Child” model, where school campuses become a one-stop-shop for children’s perceived needs. What used to be the nurse’s office where a student would lie down when feeling queasy or get a bandaid to cover a playground scrape has now become a fully functional clinic, and classrooms have morphed into miniature lecture halls where your child is given lessons about the necessity of getting all the vaccines on the CDC schedule.
**But, did you know that you, as a fully empowered and informed parent, do not have to allow your child to participate in this trend?**
First off, state law provides for exemptions for the **various health screenings** required by Texas schools, such as hearing and vision or scoliosis. [Click the button below](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTQ1ODY4NjE5OTY3ODk2MTM0JmM9ZzVtNyZlPTAmYj0xMzUxNTU3MTgzJmQ9dDV2MWYzeA==.HvMoOIH5FUQeNGugoHxmnTw6hJ4vReZwq-ghsn3gICM) for sample exemption templates for these screenings. Second, Texas also allows for you to opt your kids out of **any teaching topic that violates your personal convictions or beliefs**. The only action you have to take to exercise this right is for you to provide the school with written advanced notice. If you desire to opt your students out of vaccine-related TEKS, click the button below for our 2024-2025 Exemption from Instruction Form and turn it into your students’ school.

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
August 13, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**San Diego Chapter of International Longshore and Warehouse Union Endorses Kevin Faulconer for San Diego County Supervisor**
San Diego, CA —The San Diego Chapter of the International Longshore and Warehouse Union (ILWU, Local 29) proudly announced its endorsement of Kevin Faulconer for San Diego County Supervisor. This significant endorsement highlights Faulconer’s unwavering commitment to the working families of San Diego County and his proven track record of supporting labor and job growth in the region.
**“Kevin Faulconer has consistently demonstrated his dedication to the working men and women of SanDiego County,” said Anthony Soniga, president of ILWU, Local 29. “His leadership as mayor of San Diego and his clear vision for the future of our county make him the right choice to represent the interests of our members and all working families in the community. We are confident that Kevin will continue to be a strong advocate for jobs, fair wages, and the economic vitality of San Diego County as our choice for Supervisor.”**
During his tenure as mayor, Faulconer worked closely with all local unions, including ILWU, Local 29 to promote job growth, infrastructure development, and policies that support a thriving economy for residents across San Diego County. As supervisor, he’ll work to foster a business-friendly environment while ensuring that workers have a voice.
**“I am honored to receive the endorsement of the San Diego Chapter of the International Longshore and Warehouse Union,” said Faulconer. “The hard-working men and women of the ILWU are the backbone of our local economy, and I am committed to continuing to support them as County supervisor. Together, we will work to create more good-paying jobs, improve infrastructure, and ensure that San Diego County remains a place where working families can thrive.”**
As the race for San Diego County Supervisor heats up, Faulconer’s campaign continues to gain momentum with key endorsements from labor and business leaders alike. The support of the ILWU adds to a growing coalition of voters and organizations who believe that Faulconer is the candidate best equipped to address the growing challenges facing San Diego County.

body:
I’m typing this email as quickly as I can...

| |

---
| | | My fellow Americans:

**I 'm writing you this message as fast as I can because early voting officially begins for the 2024 Presidential Election in less than 30 days.** To put this in perspective - in the last presidential election, 71% of voters cast their ballots BEFORE Election Day. And just look at how early the votes start in key swing states this year:
🗓️ North Carolina - **September 6th**
🗓️ Pennsylvania - **September 16th **
🗓️ Wisconsin - **September 19th**
🗓️ Michigan - **September 21st**
🗓️ Georgia - **October 7th**
🗓️ Arizona - **October 9th**
🗓️ Nevada - **October 19th**
Now I'm afraid I have some bad news...

The Democrat Machine is unloading its $300+ million warchest to obliterate Conservative campaigns in every swing race. Not to mention, they're hammering battleground states with billboards, attack ads, commercials, and ballot-harvesting operations to tip the scale in their favor.

I know we can win these swing states but we have less than 30 days to correct course. _**[That's why I am asking you to chip in 25 bucks right now to get our message out to every voter before the first votes are cast!](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/jXox8GMEgNRVz0PZEuQNyQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoni-~~ "That's why I am asking you to chip in 25 bucks right now to get our message out to every voter before the first votes are cast!")**_

Listen:

According to the latest reports, we are gaining major ground in terms of voter registration data and the generic ballot polling. We have a WINNING message and WINNING candidates. The only problem is we are LOSING the fundraising race.

_In fact, the Democrat Machine has outraised us to the tune of 50 million dollars. _

**We can 't just sit around praying someone else will step up in these final days. No. That is a recipe for disaster come Election Day.**

Overcoming the Left's historic fundraising edge will take a MONUMENTAL effort from our entire grassroots team. _Yes, that includes you._

I'm not asking you to cut a huge check or give more than your family can afford. But if you can spare a few bucks to help defeat the Democrat Machine once and for all, I'd be eternally grateful. _**[In fact, if every Conservative in the country pitches in JUST ten or twenty bucks, we would eliminate their fundraising advantage just in time for early voting to start.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/jXox8GMEgNRVz0PZEuQNyQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoni-~~ "In fact, if every Conservative in the country pitches in JUST ten or twenty bucks, we would eliminate their fundraising advantage just in time for early voting to start. ")**_

Regardless, thanks for taking the time to read this message. I appreciate your time and I wish you the best.

For America,

Steve Scalise
_House Majority Leader_

Friend, I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our "leaders" in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn't know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=46facba584a343cc821696930e8803ac&_e=FSB4ZJCP2D9qNwUzalA3vVF0a5lp9QOAbpjWwzDhgD-jLRFX8RwHed1uH-xFrgnUpIp4JZvmDq3MTPBRZIg3zHrjn87CX-QLvzyK03VNSFUH9avxaZ3zIJEMb3cXSCnwBznBoLYPKbIlIePoU5IUxUNk4O-Y7uK0601ebkxTzEzbofl98MqlZ8rPCk_yAcaq-7ymnS_n6is3Fcgobmi2nmCISmBsKKJDua9z-aG2HcoEGQS5Er3WsWrbSsUjqzAj-PlXxDDk3s4H60_F9FJxU2tQaXB_UvOa2UoYW1uLE1DlYD5YknEi8d7UVXphe_YUKUdABZSvOD9_01mk4RBnv1l8GAa9w6RYD90Tg-TM6XQ%3D)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I'm proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn't like you'd see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That 's what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we're going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.

Peter,
Even after January 6th, Donald Trump never stopped lying about the 2020 election. So, it’s no surprise that when Joe Biden passed the torch to Kamala Harris, Trump’s 2024 election lie began to take shape.
According to Trump, by changing nominees, Democrats are once again plotting to steal the November election.
Of course, Trump’s claims have no basis in fact. But then again, neither does his absurd assertion that photos of a massive Kamala Harris rally this weekend were faked using artificial intelligence.
**[We’ll discuss more about Trump’s attempts to delegitimize the 2024 election in a moment, but if you support COURIER’s mission to stop election lies from spreading in 2024, can you chip in $20 now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90751014/491544185/-593472309?refcode=20240813-EM-TrumpElectionFraud&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2EyMDJiY2MtOTk1OS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=uwpe9AJIxKxxie3q3OQPOYVo6tE2mVlBF4b9PLNNvwc=)**
When we think of Trump’s stolen election claims in 2020, we mostly recall what happened after November – the attempt to replace electors, pressure campaigns in states like Georgia to audit election results, and, of course, the “Stop the Steal” rally and the violent attack on the Capitol on January 6.
**But these conspiracies didn’t emerge overnight. Trump and his allies spent 2020 priming his audience to question any result they didn’t like.**
From spreading lies about early and absentee voting to accusing poll workers of rigging results, by the time voters went to the polls in 2020, Donald Trump’s base was already conditioned to believe that a Joe Biden victory could only happen if Democrats stole the election.
Now, with Kamala Harris showing real momentum and strength, Trump is priming his base once again.
**According to the _New York Times_ , Donald Trump has explicitly said Democrats are trying to cheat him by replacing Biden on the ticket, just as they did in 2020 by changing voting rules because of COVID.**
His campaign pollster and strategists are baselessly claiming that the polls are wrong. Their argument essentially boils down to this: the only way the polls could be accurate is if they showed Donald Trump ahead.
**So Trump is lying again—what’s new? **
But, Peter, we’ve already seen what happens when Trump lies and the right-wing media amplifies those lies. Thanks to Trump and Fox News, polling suggests that a majority of Republicans now believe that Democrats stole the 2020 election.

We correct the record in real time by making factual journalism freely available in the online spaces where voters are most likely to encounter election lies and conspiracies. clean_body: Evidence shows Trump is trailing. He says all the evidence is fake. Peter, Even after January 6th, Donald Trump never stopped lying about the 2020 election. So, it’s no surprise that when Joe Biden passed the torch to Kamala Harris, Trump’s 2024 election lie began to take shape. According to Trump, by changing nominees, Democrats are once again plotting to steal the November election. Of course, Trump’s claims have no basis in fact. But then again, neither does his absurd assertion that photos of a massive Kamala Harris rally this weekend were faked using artificial intelligence. = When we think of Trump’s stolen election claims in 2020, we mostly recall what happened after November – the attempt to replace electors, pressure campaigns in states like Georgia to audit election results, and, of course, the “Stop the Steal” rally and the violent attack on the Capitol on January 6. But these conspiracies didn’t emerge overnight. Trump and his allies spent 2020 priming his audience to question any result they didn’t like. From spreading lies about early and absentee voting to accusing poll workers of rigging results, by the time voters went to the polls in 2020, Donald Trump’s base was already conditioned to believe that a Joe Biden victory could only happen if Democrats stole the election. Now, with Kamala Harris showing real momentum and strength, Trump is priming his base once again. According to the New York Times , Donald Trump has explicitly said Democrats are trying to cheat him by replacing Biden on the ticket, just as they did in 2020 by changing voting rules because of COVID. His campaign pollster and strategists are baselessly claiming that the polls are wrong. Their argument essentially boils down to this: the only way the polls could be accurate is if they showed Donald Trump ahead. So Trump is lying again—what’s new? But, Peter, we’ve already seen what happens when Trump lies and the right-wing media amplifies those lies. Thanks to Trump and Fox News, polling suggests that a majority of Republicans now believe that Democrats stole the 2020 election. The good news is that we’ve seen this play out before, and at COURIER, we’re ready to stop the spread of election lies in our 11 swing state newsrooms. We correct the record in real time by making factual journalism freely available in the online spaces where voters are most likely to encounter election lies and conspiracies. Last month, we thought the die had been cast. President Biden was well on his way to a historic loss, and Kamala Harris was nowhere to be seen.

Hundreds of questions must be answered over the next few months, and I’m asking for your input.

Friend,

So far, it appears that Democrats are enthusiastic about Kamala's candidacy. After all, they've sent her campaign more than $200 million in just over one week. But how long can the enthusiasm last with a far-left, radical progressive record like Kamala Harris??

Hundreds of questions must be answered over the next few months, and _**[I'm asking for your input.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/zp_iOC9wBdpcop9UClxatg~~/AARclAA~)**_

**[Would you please answer ten brief questions right now? We'll use your responses to determine whether we need to recalibrate our campaign's overall direction.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/zp_iOC9wBdpcop9UClxatg~~/AARclAA~)**
**[<< BEGIN SENATE SURVEY >>](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/zp_iOC9wBdpcop9UClxatg~~/AARclAA~)**
The dynamics of the forthcoming election have changed tremendously. Now that Democrats have ditched President Biden and elevated his vice president, Kamala Harris, does anyone know what's _**[really](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/zp_iOC9wBdpcop9UClxatg~~/AARclAA~)**_ going to happen in November?

Last month, we thought the die had been cast. President Biden was well on his way to a historic loss, and Kamala Harris was nowhere to be seen.

Then, everything changed in an instant. You know how it went. Barack Obama and Nancy Pelosi pushed Joe Biden to the curb to "save democracy" and anointed their preferred candidate, Kamala Harris, as the Democrats' new presidential nominee.

The choice the liberal party bosses made was interesting, to say the least, for several reasons:
* **Kamala Harris knew about Joe Biden 's mental decline and said NOTHING.**

* **Kamala Harris was complicit in the botched Afghanistan withdrawal -- she said so herself.**

* **Kamala Harris was rated the MOST liberal United States Senator during her tenure in the chamber. **

But one thing is clear as I write this email: We must end the radical Biden-Harris-Tester agenda.

Please do me a personal favor and fill out the brief questionnaire I've linked in this email.
For America's Future,

I first met Sam Brown in the burn unit. He'd just returned from Afghanistan where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban. He was injured by a roadside bomb and had a long road to recovery. I was assigned as his dietitian in rehab and was very impressed by him. Here was a young man terribly injured while serving his country, but his heart was full of faith. He fought with every fiber of his being to recover so he could return to serve with his men in Afghanistan. And even when it became clear that he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he didn't skip a beat. Sam had to relearn everything. He had prepared for his entire life to spend his career fighting for his country in the military. After his life plans were dashed in just 60 seconds, he re-focused his vision on serving others in a new way. Before we were married, and before we were even dating, Sam and I became friends. I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced, and he was honest with me. He was concerned for my Salvation – and for that matter so was I. He challenged me to reconnect with God and start going to church again. As he and I grew closer, he helped me rediscover my faith. Now here we are 15 years later. We have 3 kids, I'm a Bible-believing momma, and Sam is running for Senate to keep serving our nation and restore hope, leadership, and accountability. body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Dear Fellow American,

Every day there is a story in the news about voter
fraud. Most of them are from the leftists in the media telling
you voter fraud doesn't exist. But they are lying to you.

Not only does it exist, but it is a very real
threat to the future of our republic.

In response to this, The Heritage Foundation
created the Election Fraud Database. This database contains 1,500
proven instances of election fraud. This is not an exhaustive
list of election fraud cases across the country, but they do
prove that election fraud is a major issue.

At The Heritage Foundation, we work with
conservative policymakers to create the best policy solutions to
reduce voter fraud and improve election integrity across America.

To help you navigate difficult conversations
surrounding election fraud, we want to share five of the most
shocking cases from our database. These cases include fraudulent
ballots, ballot harvesting schemes, and more.

If you care as much about election fraud as I do
then please get your FREE copy of The Heritage Foundation's
latest eBook, 5 Shocking Cases of Election Fraud.

In the eBook, you'll read about

Different schemes people used to get their
candidate elected

The steps our government took to correct the
elections

The criminal consequences people face for their
illegal actions

You'll get instant access to your FREE eBook right
now using this secure link:
https://secured.heritage.org/free-5-shocking-cases-of-election-fraud-ebook/

Please use these stories to educate yourself on the
destructive impact of election fraud and spread the word to help
safeguard our country's future.

To get your free copy of "5 Shocking Cases of
Election Fraud" today, please click this secure link:
https://secured.heritage.org/free-5-shocking-cases-of-election-fraud-ebook/

Thank you for being involved in the fight to uphold
the conservative principles that make our nation great.

All the best,

Kevin D. Roberts, Ph.D.

| Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=01705fa5c31f4b71a03ddedf22c5bb28&_e=st8hPkybf2Ezu8KG9v885X0Wu1WT_J_x0oFMj0k8DbtbQJfE9aLCcBIsaxdFLgPxvKM0kl3Db7eQCAleFBzissItvU_XTYnGDXjJrVR1ZE_ARd6PEGJog2uqaFuGYm93WrJeudxUciU3CJOw8YZ3s9yN6wphu88weV83axCV8YBKc9sZ6Cn8khd5edCFCNq2dTiKio9GGfCFOrHvtI_9tK1dklBaYCp73Uwqkf3TA6jU1hQBu77oOBZCGhNfmQC9rg5RLT4NYzo5pTgtQWdy6nzUduqPK7BeXDuj0re5o5Xz0ObNSr_T4OfO7OShS1s2B9YptBTqByy0X2wA1oV9Xq1JBVsL49VS7FMr8YVs0BbD9HPc-TY8YQU708uUXF-0xlHI3HgfTGL5s5Aav8uVxLJuJb-APHeLhImcoaraDcI%3D) **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. **[**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=01705fa5c31f4b71a03ddedf22c5bb28&_e=st8hPkybf2Ezu8KG9v885X0Wu1WT_J_x0oFMj0k8DbtbQJfE9aLCcBIsaxdFLgPxvKM0kl3Db7eQCAleFBzissItvU_XTYnGDXjJrVR1ZE_ARd6PEGJog2uqaFuGYm93WrJeudxUciU3CJOw8YZ3s9yN6wphu88weV83axCV8YBKc9sZ6Cn8khd5edCFCNq2dTiKio9GGfCFOrHvtI_9tK1dklBaYCp73Uwqkf3TA6jU1hQBu77oOBZCGhNfmQC9rg5RLT4NYzo5pTgtQWdy6seu3PfziOEWsCRuzncaNs0dBdgJSFUBsCfsf0MglgYe0-4lty44Omo5V0X_O5bnXfqyQvW0Sp7gu-S5HIet4lqy5c-ZqfOf-UYQo0r42jr0_BOodoMlIhMEKRmTJkPq3FZ7QxNaZgtEjeGLA5Xxdds%3D)**

I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn?

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=01705fa5c31f4b71a03ddedf22c5bb28&_e=st8hPkybf2Ezu8KG9v885X0Wu1WT_J_x0oFMj0k8DbtbQJfE9aLCcBIsaxdFLgPxvKM0kl3Db7eQCAleFBzissItvU_XTYnGDXjJrVR1ZE_ARd6PEGJog2uqaFuGYm93WrJeudxUciU3CJOw8YZ3s9yN6wphu88weV83axCV8YBKc9sZ6Cn8khd5edCFCNq2dTiKio9GGfCFOrHvtI_9tK1dklBaYCp73Uwqkf3TA6jU1hQBu77oOBZCGhNfmQC9rg5RLT4NYzo5pTgtQWdy6p_FjO9xHMTQXAC_BQGyOoLDphT4c0qiB-hfP9otmYgrTvf5o3q3IEXYOYwP9mFU03hMJqrkg5ILZ-oSbTmC9Zwhgd5tzDu-j9jYtwX-7dYL3D_2jC6KHO88aFbz5DMepopER6MivgQcCpSPRR5Tib0%3D)

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson

Peter, down-ballot races are built different. While campaigns toward the top of the ticket rake in big money, state campaigns are often run on lean budgets. Take a look at these stats from the 2020 elections in Arizona:
* U.S. Senate: The Democratic and Republican nominees raised a combined total of over _$170 million_.
* State legislature: Nearly 200 candidates for the State House and Senate, all put together, raised about 5% of that — around $9.6 million in total. On average, each Democrat raised $48,450, and each Republican brought in $51,490.

Now Arizona is one of our priority states for the 2024 elections. Democrats only need to flip two seats each in the House and Senate to gain control of both chambers, which would pave the way toward strengthening the state’s redistricting process. **As we work across the country to elect Democracy Defenders to critical positions in state government, a little goes a long way. body:
But Nevada Dems aren’t done attacking Jill yet

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nevada_victory&n=1)
---
Peter,
In June, the Nevada Democrats sued the Green Party of Nevada and the Nevada Secretary of State in an attempt to kick us off the ballot even after we worked hard to collect over 29,000 signatures in the scorching heat – almost three times the 10,096 required! ---

Friend, there are a few moments that have truly been life-changing for me. [**Before I humbly ask you to contribute to our campaign,**](https://cg4ut.us/l/Tn0nTuILHWjA)**** I want to tell you that I'm a first-time candidate. **I've been unsure about a lot of things, but when it came to joining this race, I knew that I had to get involved.**
---
| [ ](https://cg4ut.us/l/4N0713uU3fVo)
---
**The first time I picked up a pair of skis,** I had no idea that my dream of becoming a professional skier would lead me to skiing and summiting some of the world's tallest mountains like Cho Oyu and Mt. Everest, or being the first woman to finish the Chuting Gallery—a guidebook to 90 of Utah's hardest ski lines—or becoming a passionate climate advocate. **When I posted on social media for the first time,** I had no idea that it would give me a platform to spread my climate advocacy further, speaking on crucial issues like climate change and public lands, which are so important here in Utah. I didn't know that social media would become a big part of my career either! **But when I signed the declaration of candidacy form** to run for the U.S. Senate, I knew that I would be dedicating a large part of my life to a movement that meant so much to so many people. Advocating for reproductive rights, our environment, working families, and our democracy—running for U.S. Senate has changed my life. [**Friend, I'm so grateful for all of the support that this campaign has garnered over the months, and our team is working around the clock to win this November. We can't let a career politician who sides with the far-right put our communities and America at risk. Will you chip in to join our campaign and help us take on our opponent's network of dark-money donors?**](https://cg4ut.us/l/Cdaofyh2Ic3u)

body:

Friend,
For years, Michael has been working to permanently expand the Child Tax Credit.
When it was temporarily expanded during the pandemic, it cut child poverty nearly in half and reduced hunger for families with kids by a quarter. It helped working families get by when they needed help most and made a huge difference for our kids.
But Republicans in Congress let it expire. And earlier this month, 43 Republicans in the Senate voted against helping poor kids and sank a vote to pass an expanded Child Tax Credit. JD Vance didn’t even bother to show up.

body:
This victory is just the beginning. As we celebrate this monumental achievement, we must also prepare for the battles ahead.

| | |
# Cornel West for President

[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nc_win&n=1)
---
# **When we stand together,****we can overcome.**
---
Dear Family, I’m thrilled to share some incredible news with you – news that marks a major milestone in our fight for a fair and just democracy. Thanks to your unwavering support, the Justice For All Party (JFA) has successfully challenged the North Carolina State Board of Elections and secured our rightful place on the 2024 general election ballot! This victory isn’t just a win for our campaign – it’s a win for every voter who believes in the power of choice and the strength of democracy. The United States District Court for the Eastern District of North Carolina has ruled in our favor, affirming that the Board’s refusal to certify our party, despite meeting all legal signature requirements, was a violation of the First and Fourteenth Amendments. This decision is a powerful reminder that the voices of the people cannot be silenced.
---
---

---
|
## **“The court's decision is not just a win for JFA but a victory for every North Carolinian who believes in the power of choice and the strength of democracy.”**
Justice for All Party North Carolina Co-Chair, Italo Medelius
---
---
As we celebrate this monumental achievement, we must also prepare for the battles ahead. Our campaign is more energized than ever, and with your help, we’re ready to take our message to voters across the country.

Friends - I was just officially declared the winner of the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate in Michigan. And Trump-endorsed Mike Rogers was declared the winner of the Republican primary. That means we have our general election match-up. _It's on. And the 90 day sprint to November has begun._ I'll have more to say about Mike Rogers and what happens next in the coming days. But for now, I am going to spend some time thanking supporters and volunteers who have gathered together in Detroit to celebrate our victory. While that happens, I'll be keeping a close eye on our fundraising numbers tonight. With everything going on in politics, our opponent will get a boost, and we need one too. This is a big moment for the country, and both of our Senate campaigns. And the candidate whose supporters show up most will have a big advantage. So I am asking: [**Can you take all of the positive energy of this moment and help me get the general election off to a strong start by splitting a $20 contribution between Serve America and my campaign for U.S. Senate? body:

Peter,
I’m an actress, director, singer, longtime activist, and, above all, a citizen of our great democracy. And as a citizen with a platform larger than most, I believe it is not only my right but also my duty to express my concerns. So here goes Peter:
**I’m concerned by what I’m seeing in Pennsylvania and national Republicans’ ruthless efforts to unseat Bob Casey and flip this battleground red.**
If the GOP succeeds in flipping Pennsylvania red, they’ll almost certainly regain control of both the Senate _and_ the White House, threatening everything from voting rights to women’s rights to the fight against climate change.
That’s why outside interest groups have started spending upwards of $75 million to defeat Bob. The stakes this November are higher than ever before. **[So before I go on, can you please chip in any amount to Bob’s re-election campaign?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240813-2?refcode=em20240813-2&recurring=1&refcode2=3852_552475_QIO6tq&akid=3852%2E552475%2EQIO6tq)**

I’m committed to electing lawmakers like Bob Casey, who believes that everyone deserves a fair shot at getting ahead and staying ahead. Bob’s opponent on the other hand is a Connecticut mega-millionaire who will do and say anything to help his own bottom line.
With the most extreme Republican party of my lifetime teetering on the edge of regaining power, we need all hands on deck. If we’re going to protect our Senate majority and the White House, we must _all_ stay informed and stay involved.

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **[National Survey on the Department of Justice](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=fee64200886d4db9ac11773790535229&_e=9Pn-UeVud1wRyju9dyxbBB6uJZxI4KcAqQszf-RNg5Nvmp-6GPd0H7b74i_VHCBWIuPngD2SbbmeLAtqvoFlcUvqv0s_dGxDRIR9bYAbEpGJSeEDbJR-1tJfRrSOQfrfg-EcSL2G2zlcvAFFumd67Uq_g7OlR_7ZJ2SSlTYNfe7BsmFrocbPNEX7Cj6xferIxqoMieaFZZ4jsfKye_IF8r_y9OTSO5bNX9AGzjXHdpx8rKD47OUPiKanB-sU4j7KxRexlcoZsMAhkJHTX-msimCwwHycYVPoBB6JugYOdSgCtWlyC3RRUdFcJIweVIF6qC5INlq5VHhitJq4c7tCiFCS-RIRl-pac_t33Ox7f11DOVVXD1EuklvxpwEXX_u8-Xti2eP2WngO981Aur1mJg%3D%3D).**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the [Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=fee64200886d4db9ac11773790535229&_e=9Pn-UeVud1wRyju9dyxbBB6uJZxI4KcAqQszf-RNg5Nvmp-6GPd0H7b74i_VHCBWIuPngD2SbbmeLAtqvoFlcUvqv0s_dGxDRIR9bYAbEpGJSeEDbJR-1tJfRrSOQfrfg-EcSL2G2zlcvAFFumd67Uq_g7OlR_7ZJ2SSlTYNfe7BsmFrocbPNEX7Cj6xferIxqoMieaFZZ4jsfKye_IF8r_y9OTSO5bNX9AGzjXHdpwmKeshWHFhQVF1ZZqZb_Eg1L0_5p0MCrdLrJOGJVdRjqje-t4SR6jB8JOgFwsfWmPlMG-M3mDKSZFCllsvJn0kYeqmDBXimTxKBGdsc-5xjsJn5jkpluSxs4Z0eQwmFCw_tu7PjfYqQq3u6wPUTMganopmgzmoXFhMnEPlzNnZSQ%3D%3D).**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. I'm writing about this because legacy media and too few elected officials care to discuss it, but it is critical to our nation's future economic and social health.
My wife and I care for our three amazing children as well as our parents. We're just two of the 53 million family caregivers in the U.S. -- one in five adults -- who often feel stressed out, overworked, and isolated. Those of us who care for parents and kids are known as the "sandwich generation," and as Americans live longer, this generation is rapidly growing.
Right now, many of us do not know how we're going to make ends meet, devastating our financial, mental, and physical health. It is critical we properly address the dire needs of this generation, or we risk economic and social catastrophe. **It shouldn 't be this hard**, and in fact, it doesn't need to be. But how do we even begin to change this status quo?
**Let 's Address This.**
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=147667053&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ3NjY3MDUzLCJpYXQiOjE3MjM1NzU3MDcsImV4cCI6MTcyNjE2NzcwNywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.pJqlQRHER6T4mpM2Xu8RKvR2XB2kFnU6wRRREXQOmZA)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/83788109-3295-477b-bdac-1172320d760c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Sandwich Generation. Credit: Terrence Horan/MarketWatch
## **The cost of care**
The cost of care is debilitating, often forcing people to have to choose between a paycheck or caring for themselves, or for a sick or disabled family member. This is because the U.S. has little to no care infrastructure in place, leaving family caregivers to try and fill in the gaps and spend, on average, [more than 24 hours a week on care](https://substack.com/redirect/b9241ed7-acf5-4ce4-b53e-0e895fadc509?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). That number is even higher for Black and Latinx caregivers. In fact, we're the only industrialized nation on Earth that doesn't guarantee universal paid family medical leave.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bb375892-c2a2-484c-8788-fd9aabd53712?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Without national paid family or medical leave, families lose a total of over $22 billion a year in wages alone. Childcare costs families an average of $16,000 a year. And aging and disability care at home, where nearly all Americans want to receive it, costs an astronomical $64,000 a year on average. Meanwhile, care workers, who make it all possible, earn an average of just $15 per hour--a poverty wage in this economy. This is both debilitating now, and painfully unsustainable long term.
## **Collective care is the solution**
Many of us, regardless of ideology or creed, feel we have personally failed when the people in our lives cannot get the care they need, when in reality it is a systemic failure. As a nation we have not invested in the systems or policies that enable people to easily access care or provide it.
Our elected leaders must build a care system we can all depend on. A universal healthcare model that treats care as a human right for all, not a privilege for the wealthy. In fact, far from increasing costs or decreasing quality of care, a recent Yale University study found that such a model [will annually save Americans $450 billion in healthcare costs, and annually save at least 68,000 lives](https://substack.com/redirect/b80c593c-0329-45c3-a62c-e88e68a42fa5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
But all is not lost, and we are making progress to make this critical healthcare access a reality. But we need a collective effort. This is where you come in!
## **How to start getting involved**
I am partnering with an amazing organization called _Caring Across Generations_ as they take 'Care on Tour' this summer, and I invite you to join me in person. Over the next month, _Caring Across_ is hosting a series of storytelling and advocacy community events in Chicago where I live, and across the country, to show how care connects us all, regardless of politics, ideology, or creed, and to advance equitable and inclusive care solutions. I am attending at least two events, and I hope to see you there.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c0b3eb8d-51d3-4650-a90e-af91d4a50fc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**First Event:** I am attending "**The Cost of Not Caring** ," a new work-in-progress performance from Sarah Jones, a Tony Award-winning playwright, comedian and activist. The show is inspired by Jones' real-life, multiracial family and features a medley of characters as they navigate the joy, frustrations and hilarity of providing and receiving care.
**I 'll be at the show in Chicago on August 18th, and [you can join me there](https://substack.com/redirect/88f84598-b57e-41a5-abb0-fcd4c4266c11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)!**
**You can also join this show in[Atlanta (September 15th)](https://substack.com/redirect/b78f4e01-263e-499e-b53d-cde32e3a33ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Detroit (September 19th)](https://substack.com/redirect/1a0a0d65-fef2-45ab-a10a-1ad1bd4c5973?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Tickets are totally free. I repeat. Tickets. Are. Free.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8f569da8-d86a-4aa6-a86a-69b179e123e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Second Event:** I am joining Caring Across Generations as they kick off a national **Care Can 't Wait Bus Tour** right here in Chicago. This rally will bring together care advocates from across the state to call for better care in Illinois and around the country.
**[Join me at the Chicago Rally on August 26.](https://substack.com/redirect/6b23c34c-4447-423a-9d36-40e22a9ab5f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
From there, the Care Can't Wait bus tour will travel to states across the Midwest and the East Coast. **[Click here to learn more about the bus tour.](https://substack.com/redirect/4fddc488-1a1f-48c7-bb78-1f8148acba51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
## **Conclusion**
One thing is for sure: We need better options for care. And that doesn't happen without systemic change. So much of caregiving feels like an individual challenge - I know I've felt that in my own family. But we can and should expect more from our leaders to provide support when we need it most. A collective approach costs less, increases quality and access to care, and is sustainable long term. But to get there, it starts with us taking action now to make it happen.
If you're able, I hope you'll take action and join the national movement for better care for all of us.

Thank you for being an awesome subscriber! When the time is right, I hope you'll consider upgrading to a $5/mo or $50/year subscription! Our current trajectory places at least 53 million Americans on a path to catastrophe -- but there is a solution, if we act now | | | Aug 13 | | | | | | | | | | | | I'm writing about this because legacy media and too few elected officials care to discuss it, but it is critical to our nation's future economic and social health. My wife and I care for our three amazing children as well as our parents. We're just two of the 53 million family caregivers in the U.S. -- one in five adults -- who often feel stressed out, overworked, and isolated. Those of us who care for parents and kids are known as the "sandwich generation," and as Americans live longer, this generation is rapidly growing. Right now, many of us do not know how we're going to make ends meet, devastating our financial, mental, and physical health. It is critical we properly address the dire needs of this generation, or we risk economic and social catastrophe. It shouldn 't be this hard, and in fact, it doesn't need to be. But how do we even begin to change this status quo? Let 's Address This. | | ---|---|--- The Sandwich Generation. Credit: Terrence Horan/MarketWatch The cost of care The cost of care is debilitating, often forcing people to have to choose between a paycheck or caring for themselves, or for a sick or disabled family member. This is because the U.S. has little to no care infrastructure in place, leaving family caregivers to try and fill in the gaps and spend, on average, . That number is even higher for Black and Latinx caregivers. In fact, we're the only industrialized nation on Earth that doesn't guarantee universal paid family medical leave. | | ---|---|--- Without national paid family or medical leave, families lose a total of over $22 billion a year in wages alone. Childcare costs families an average of $16,000 a year. And aging and disability care at home, where nearly all Americans want to receive it, costs an astronomical $64,000 a year on average. Meanwhile, care workers, who make it all possible, earn an average of just $15 per hour--a poverty wage in this economy. This is both debilitating now, and painfully unsustainable long term. Collective care is the solution Many of us, regardless of ideology or creed, feel we have personally failed when the people in our lives cannot get the care they need, when in reality it is a systemic failure. As a nation we have not invested in the systems or policies that enable people to easily access care or provide it. Our elected leaders must build a care system we can all depend on. A universal healthcare model that treats care as a human right for all, not a privilege for the wealthy. In fact, far from increasing costs or decreasing quality of care, a recent Yale University study found that such a model . But all is not lost, and we are making progress to make this critical healthcare access a reality. But we need a collective effort. This is where you come in! How to start getting involved I am partnering with an amazing organization called Caring Across Generations as they take 'Care on Tour' this summer, and I invite you to join me in person. Over the next month, Caring Across is hosting a series of storytelling and advocacy community events in Chicago where I live, and across the country, to show how care connects us all, regardless of politics, ideology, or creed, and to advance equitable and inclusive care solutions. I am attending at least two events, and I hope to see you there. | | ---|---|--- First Event: I am attending "The Cost of Not Caring ," a new work-in-progress performance from Sarah Jones, a Tony Award-winning playwright, comedian and activist. The show is inspired by Jones' real-life, multiracial family and features a medley of characters as they navigate the joy, frustrations and hilarity of providing and receiving care. I 'll be at the show in Chicago on August 18th, and ! You can also join this show in and . Tickets are totally free. I repeat. Tickets. Are. Free. | | ---|---|--- Second Event: I am joining Caring Across Generations as they kick off a national Care Can 't Wait Bus Tour right here in Chicago. This rally will bring together care advocates from across the state to call for better care in Illinois and around the country. From there, the Care Can't Wait bus tour will travel to states across the Midwest and the East Coast. Conclusion** One thing is for sure: We need better options for care. And that doesn't happen without systemic change. So much of caregiving feels like an individual challenge - I know I've felt that in my own family. But we can and should expect more from our leaders to provide support when we need it most. A collective approach costs less, increases quality and access to care, and is sustainable long term. But to get there, it starts with us taking action now to make it happen. If you're able, I hope you'll take action and join the national movement for better care for all of us. Missouri voters have long taken their freedom back at the ballot box.
Missouri voters rejected anti-union right to work laws - even when Hawley supported them.
Missouri voters expanded Medicaid.

Missouri voters legalized weed.

subject: PA AAPI for Kamala Call Follow Up and Rally Recap!

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ninageneral [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ninageneral]
Hi Friend,
Thank you so much to all of you who attended the PA AAPI for Kamala Virtual Organizing Call last week. It was so energizing to be among such diverse and inspiring community leaders with the singular vision of working together to elect our first South Asian and African American Woman as President in November .
Together, we reviewed the state of the race and outlined the grave risks posed to us all by a second term under Donald Trump. We were inspired by the National Directors of South Asians for Harris – Harini Krishnan and Neha Dewan – and got an update on the incredible work they are doing. The Chair of the PA Democratic Party , Senator Sharif Street, encouraged and applauded our actions and caught us up on the work of the state party. Several election and voter protection experts drove home the importance of voter protection volunteers and the pivotal role they can play in this election. DNC Finance Committee Member, Megan Camaisa, spoke to the painful impact on her biracial AANHPI children of their villification due to hateful anti-AANHPI rhetoric. We also heard from AAPI Democratic and Community leaders about the importance of getting organized and what's on the line.
We cannot wait for you to see what's next and hope that you are getting and staying involved wherever you fit. Here are some of the links shared in the Zoom's chat where you can get more information and continue hearing from our speakers (please let us know if we missed yours!):
South Asians for Harris [http://www.southasiansforharris2024.org]

subject: I thought I was going to hell
body:
All too aware of the punishment that awaited me in the afterlife, according to my family’s ultra conservative Southern Baptist church, I would wake up night after night with the sweats, fearing for my eternal soul. | | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsYnR9WKQjfGn170MX_JqHzOicZeChSfs_NfrtBPPqk7vb1TKXqdocdXpqhZBvHd9I5m_4LHA6TAuT6r3vMdeJS8mo8nsSSSGBV7CAOwHjs3rNnrpQY5eoACnvEIz27wGcfPTHylDPBbicbx7XsxdnQR1gyq3V_lA2y1FJjrPWm856hGx-ZDCvAkGAd1CaE0AAWwLVpEazR6bbybtsKkMqVqJK94Pvl3Fts4l4foJnlugjDL4lLjrOyBPhjbjFYCfveS5ZIUscKm5z4-YsTZ2U4KYTQdzW8aDRgNHMsPzUsR6nDnEZB9FCbC_GPwatqfAsKWTpJEeS4c_U-yJDMldRm/48v/ILiBsqvIRQuUrMvmeGqMgQ/h0/h001.n1qw4LT2Qe1_uIt1rDzQiAT_X6mJprIytJNCID1IJR4)
---
**Mel Manuel For US Congress**
---
Hi Friend - if you and I haven't met yet, I think it's important that we do. At eight years old, I knew I was queer.__ All too aware of the punishment that awaited me in the afterlife, according to my family’s ultra conservative Southern Baptist church, I would wake up night after night with the sweats, fearing for my eternal soul. My community of St. Tammany, where I live to this day, felt as unsafe as the church, and as a consequence most queer folks stayed closeted. Unsurprisingly, I didn't know any out queer people growing up which made public school difficult to say the least. In retrospect lots of my friends were on the rainbow spectrum, but this was rural Louisiana in the 90’s and it simply wasn’t safe to be out.
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsYnR9WKQjfGn170MX_JqHzOicZeChSfs_NfrtBPPqk7h9XZW_m3M0pFCFVZbM5fDb6D_DYmep5frcIVWe-JByUyfqHKGo6BW69zoU8Ayfuy0A6VuBZ_4r--5V_jdHiWnWzjwQ4JrlrD9Cs5isdCAIuv1eyNnPxN49A8p0HTk2m_WNYxS0C3DSBBt2iF8Pt34AEog3gtkft66ajwtmoEVIV_fjJ4YT1_Z1bQUPz0dSoSw3BuqQdj0h_zdSwdW5B3w5oHTW89pH3yjGoJfazDdBMVGBwjOiv3TQjRjptMTWp1LRFsr1IaB5_7b0cYOyfLSD3_V7Kur6tT_oFhwSDnQgE/48v/ILiBsqvIRQuUrMvmeGqMgQ/h1/h001.MApLyLEKKGoASNS3J600B_jUbfrwoMvXdtF_WVhVglM)
---
_Me when I was growing up._
---
For these reasons among others, (including hurricane Katrina, which interrupted my time at Tulane University), I left Louisiana for nearly a decade. When I returned, I remembered why it had been so scary growing up queer on the Northshore. The LGBTQ+ community here was isolated without any way to find each other. That’s why I co-founded**Queer Northshore** \- a group focused on building community, visibility and acceptance for LGBTQ+ locals. Since its founding 2.5 years ago, we have grown to over 2700 members, produced over 100 events, founded the first LGBTQ+ krewe to parade on the Northshore, and introduced the first local pride parade with over 600 participants. Our work organizing the LGBTQ+ community on the Northshore turned political when the extreme right in St. Tammany Parish, my home, began to call for books featuring queer and trans authors or characters to be banned from local libraries. In response, local activists and I founded the**St. Tammany Library Alliance** centered around opposing censorship and keeping our libraries a safe space for everyone.
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsYnR9WKQjfGn170MX_JqHzOicZeChSfs_NfrtBPPqk7l6mfIzMUGxaPt0RiejILm40k-s6vKuh3GmkHFHJH4J9SVkpb_vcY7SSBo_nWgoQW6TVSiuplClHNWVs6VFdIKEGHrJKJAclwLbpH3BRA5ZiGLD-X5KmPnMJ4kDiAlPDr-WsJNsqFbFpQCmSdniVyRdu7_juEwoWbODEXF1p8F7Vg8ARYszbtMWpkdvLgseMQ9ECEm5_zedfMeAAbnFLnBroK4_kFkR5jf6QoKTlIEkwN9R3oi1HWMgHP98FGEi8nKSH_MxvYKpK99Z30tpudN49R-Km_chqeeg9iKwCd91p/48v/ILiBsqvIRQuUrMvmeGqMgQ/h2/h001.JNKUlc-FG16CvLsopyvcqtb3Q_U5z-UXvUcHxy3hhIo)
---
As we fought to keep books on shelves, my friend Katie Darling, the last Democrat to run for Congress in this district, passed the proverbial torch by asking me to run. I was apprehensive at first, but the erasure of our community via the book banning movement and hundreds of anti-LGBTQ+ bills nationwide convinced me to be a voice for queer and trans Louisianians. I announced my candidacy the following Spring. I was a K-12 teacher for over a decade, but fearing retribution for speaking frankly on trans issues, I retired from public school teaching and took a position as Director of Operations at the Louisiana Abortion Fund. I hope to talk more about my experience with the abortion fund in future communications, but for now I will say that women in Louisiana are already living Project 2025 - abortion is completely illegal here.
