At eight years old, I knew I was queer. All too aware of the punishment that awaited me in the afterlife, according to my family’s ultra conservative Southern Baptist church, I would wake up night after night with the sweats, fearing for my eternal soul. My community of St. Tammany, where I live to this day, felt as unsafe as the church, and as a consequence most queer folks stayed closeted. Unsurprisingly, I didn't know any out queer people growing up which made public school difficult to say the least. In retrospect lots of my friends were on the rainbow spectrum, but this was rural Louisiana in the 90’s and it simply wasn’t safe to be out. | Me when I was growing up. For these reasons among others, (including hurricane Katrina, which interrupted my time at Tulane University), I left Louisiana for nearly a decade. When I returned, I remembered why it had been so scary growing up queer on the Northshore. The LGBTQ+ community here was isolated without any way to find each other. That’s why I co-foundedQueer Northshore \- a group focused on building community, visibility and acceptance for LGBTQ+ locals. Since its founding 2.5 years ago, we have grown to over 2700 members, produced over 100 events, founded the first LGBTQ+ krewe to parade on the Northshore, and introduced the first local pride parade with over 600 participants. Our work organizing the LGBTQ+ community on the Northshore turned political when the extreme right in St. Tammany Parish, my home, began to call for books featuring queer and trans authors or characters to be banned from local libraries. In response, local activists and I founded theSt. Tammany Library Alliance centered around opposing censorship and keeping our libraries a safe space for everyone. | As we fought to keep books on shelves, my friend Katie Darling, the last Democrat to run for Congress in this district, passed the proverbial torch by asking me to run. I was apprehensive at first, but the erasure of our community via the book banning movement and hundreds of anti-LGBTQ+ bills nationwide convinced me to be a voice for queer and trans Louisianians. I announced my candidacy the following Spring. I was a K-12 teacher for over a decade, but fearing retribution for speaking frankly on trans issues, I retired from public school teaching and took a position as Director of Operations at the Louisiana Abortion Fund. Fellow Patriot,

I wanted to take a moment to share something that worries me about our society.

Too many black students despise America.

Too many black students despise white people.

And many people believe that all black students should think the same way.

My name is **Jasmyn Jordan** , and I'm a student at the University of Iowa. As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to "conform" to the identity that the Left created for me.

White liberals and radical African Americans wanted me to promote Critical Race Theory and speak out about my "oppression."

But my parents didn't raise me to be a victim. My dad is a hard-working, patriotic American truck driver who listens to conservative talk radio. Often, my parents reminded me that in America we can all have our own opinions thanks to freedom of speech.

At the University of Iowa, I chose to become a committed conservative student through Young America's Foundation (YAF), the nation's leading youth outreach organization. I decided more students at the University of Iowa need to be warned about Critical Race Theory and instead hear your conservative ideas!

_The backlash from the campus Left was almost immediate._

The campus Left attacked me, calling me a "token," a bigot, a Nazi, and even a white supremacist.

Even today, they don't like seeing that there is a black female conservative who is actively participating and leading in Young America's Foundation.

But my parents raised me to have courage, so **[I proudly began to share your ideas with my fellow students through YAF](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=541b72d55c3247749af6ec48c780c597&_e=017Lr1KFXVkwegXl2wtyr3ZXoYkch2InJL6XquNrcsPIkePp_IzSHg4i7zUI23pQeALxc1W7iLnRgFXIIjewy4U64KV1SCXdV2qoOA7pkPkh5zzbL-Ha2dEvVndr6r8QbryLR6TCl18GhpJMlbYrDmfn10Fr0nfDzBQ4bGOHQe7jr2eJ9hk0tlOonhiQga8mF8ZPk9Jx-6nG2UOYAGDQwct0LOLvhqHTxzw9G2TfjN4OsN5ZTM13NpOuQ49xw-Y3PfRmsdWityiEdbHCGZzkJ5Bn_HU5Z3Bz9qFGYTe1qrcP2Qo-RmyTSgU26xmY_-2vSeEbAmXoiHFspdLKIvoEvJkyDuwVHMKnxkJN-9zsb_Lyw2IOzEEs0fOZqmUYhxHM)**. My fellow conservative students and I took the lead to host YAF speakers on campus, including **Matt Walsh** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , **Vince Everett Ellison** , award-winning swimmer **Paula Scanlan** , and others.

We were determined to share your conservative ideas with as many students as possible at the University of Iowa.

I even testified before the U.S. House Judiciary Committee about the personal attacks I faced for defending free speech on campus. And I have now been appointed as the new national chairwoman for Young Americans for Freedom to oversee the largest coast-to-coast network of young conservatives! [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=541b72d55c3247749af6ec48c780c597&_e=017Lr1KFXVkwegXl2wtyr3ZXoYkch2InJL6XquNrcsPIkePp_IzSHg4i7zUI23pQeALxc1W7iLnRgFXIIjewy4U64KV1SCXdV2qoOA7pkPkh5zzbL-Ha2dEvVndr6r8QbryLR6TCl18GhpJMlbYrDmfn10Fr0nfDzBQ4bGOHQe7jr2eJ9hk0tlOonhiQga8mF8ZPk9Jx-6nG2UOYAGDQwSj5sZdKtMz0caVOlYrx1sutEeFFGOeJTsogPVRMyxGwTPLpOcbbfqrvZTzHnOYq58lCr9tD7DX3GAdya5oPbBJCAk2o72EfhO3iq29MCR33-huVmVJz8IOdF_CBMQXmIPWBEYukbeXSef59hP1Kbf0pxOv6eILEPGeOc93nXGv6) More young people, especially young African Americans, need to hear that America is not "racist" and instead be inspired by your conservative values!

That's why each day I do everything I can to warn my fellow students of the dangers of Critical Race Theory and share your values with my peers at the University of Iowa.

And it's why I'm so passionate about Young America's Foundation-the most effective youth outreach organization recruiting the largest audiences of young people into the Conservative Movement.

Without YAF, none of my conservative activism would have been possible.

**But we can 't keep recruiting students at the University of Iowa or on college campuses nationwide without your help.** There are thousands of African-American students at the University of Iowa who need to hear the dangers and immorality of Critical Race Theory. You can help educate new, young audiences!

Specifically, we need 50 passionate conservatives to step forward before midnight with a gift of $50, so Young America's Foundation can inspire thousands more students on campuses nationwide with the truth about the values that make us great.

According to one poll, only 36% of young people ages 18 to 24 are proud of being American. But your gift right now will help change that. It changed it for me, and I know it will change it for students like me who only hear about how bad their country is instead of why they should be proud of it.

Here's where you can securely make your gift to Young America's Foundation to inspire and recruit young americans to save our country: [**https://secure.yaf.org/inspire-and-recruit-young-americans**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=541b72d55c3247749af6ec48c780c597&_e=017Lr1KFXVkwegXl2wtyr3ZXoYkch2InJL6XquNrcsPIkePp_IzSHg4i7zUI23pQeALxc1W7iLnRgFXIIjewy4U64KV1SCXdV2qoOA7pkPkh5zzbL-Ha2dEvVndr6r8QbryLR6TCl18GhpJMlbYrDmfn10Fr0nfDzBQ4bGOHQe7jr2eJ9hk0tlOonhiQga8mF8ZPk9Jx-6nG2UOYAGDQwV4uo7-AXzLBXensdA6qsn8yFRLtiGuwaGiHVnO9uM-DfCg5WRYlMlScVOcMbEXe0kCIpUQdsCf8-fTHB0kMIeCoEb1aCawAFDDyUJ-NoSKGtejzhsCWBFYVIQ8QHRXDbVCSPez6XtWKZqGcI-knsexYmRFw4na8lioesuCaRKyV)

I'm so grateful you are standing with us to pass on your ideas to future generations. Together we will reach more young people with the values that make America exceptional.

Gratefully,

Jasmyn Jordan
**Chairwoman, Young Americans for Freedom**
**Chairwoman, University of Iowa YAF**

Peter, we already know that the 2024 election is going to be _really_ close — a true “toss-up.” But what does that really look like? Well, consider these stats from the 2020 election:
* **GEORGIA:** President Biden won by 0.23%.
* **ARIZONA:** President Biden won by 0.31%.
* **WISCONSIN:** President Biden won by 0.63%.

These margins of victory, although incredibly slim, say something very important about the importance of grassroots support. Without people-powered campaigns like ours, where grassroots donors chipped in $10, $25, and even $3 when they could, Donald Trump could have won a second term. # From the desk of Dr. Asif Mahmood

| Dear Friend,
We’ve all seen the memes and heard the jokes about J.D. Vance as Trump’s VP pick. While some may find them amusing, the reality of Vance’s views is far from funny—it’s alarming. His recent comments are not just out of touch; they’re downright dangerous. Dangerous for our mothers, wives, sisters, and daughters.
Vance’s stance on divorce and domestic violence, where he suggests that women should remain in abusive and violent marriages, reveals a deeply disturbing disregard for women’s safety and well-being. As a proud Girl Dad, these attitudes make my blood boil.
But it’s not just about one man’s disturbing views. Vance’s remarks, including those about Vice President Kamala Harris, reflect a broader, regressive trend within the Republican Party—a trend that threatens to undo the progress we’ve made toward gender equality. This kind of rhetoric underscores the urgent need for leadership that genuinely respects and protects women’s rights.
Please consider making a contribution by[****](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=99880a788e&e=7b1b739a89)[**clicking here**](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=22d92edfed&e=7b1b739a89) now, to ensure our next President and Vice President respect women and all their rights.
That’s why it’s more important than ever to support Vice President Harris, as she continues her historic journey. Her leadership stands as a direct counter to the harmful ideologies being promoted by Trump, Vance, and their allies. Together, we can fight for a future where every woman and child is valued, protected, and respected.Please join me in supporting my friend Kamala by **donating today**. Your contribution will help us ensure that we can continue to combat this dangerous rhetoric and work toward a future where equality and justice prevail.
Thank you for your support and friendship.
Sincerely,

Together, we can fight for a future where every woman and child is valued, protected, and respected.Please join me in supporting my friend Kamala by donating today. body:
Codifying the right to an abortion is on the ballot in Nevada this fall and they need our help.

Hey there.
Gavin Newsom here, reaching out to ask if you can please make a contribution to Nevadans for Reproductive Freedom.
Codifying the right to an abortion is on the ballot in Nevada this fall and they need our help.
As a bonus, this ballot measure (called Question 6), has a chance to boost Democratic turnout in a way that will help us in the presidential race and the Senate race -- both races we need to win in order to keep the White House and Senate.
So please. Donate $3 or whatever you can. No amount is too small.
[**https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/Nevada-Amendment**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cfd-em-nev-repro?refcode=em240813-1-subs&refcode2=2174_4767699_9gXXmq&akid=2174%2E4767699%2E9gXXmq)
The truth is, until we have a Democratic president along with a Senate that is willing to bypass the filibuster to protect abortion rights, we have to go state-by-state to protect those rights.
We did that in California.
Now Nevada is trying to do the same.
But there are, of course, right-wing organizations trying to stop them. First they tried in the courts, now they'll try at the ballot box.
But if Nevadans for Reproductive Freedom has the resources they need, they're going to win. And in doing-so they'll help Kamala Harris and Jacky Rosen win their races in the state at the same time.
That's why I am reaching out with this important request. Early voting is right around the corner, so please:
[**Use this link to contribute $3, or whatever you can, directly to Nevadans for Reproductive Freedom. They will put your donation right to work protecting abortion access in Nevada and turning out Democrats this November.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cfd-em-nev-repro?refcode=em240813-1-subs&refcode2=2174_4767699_9gXXmq&akid=2174%2E4767699%2E9gXXmq)

And just look at how early the votes start in key swing states this year:
🗓️ North Carolina - **September 6th**

🗓️ Wisconsin - **September 19th**
🗓️ Michigan - **September 21st**
🗓️ Georgia - **October 7th**
🗓️ Arizona - **October 9th**

The Democrat Machine is unloading its $300+ million warchest to obliterate Conservative campaigns in every swing race. Not to mention, they're hammering battleground states with billboards, attack ads, commercials, and ballot-harvesting operations to tip the scale in their favor.

I know we can win these swing states but we have less than 30 days to correct course. _**[That's why I am asking you to chip in 25 bucks right now to get our message out to every voter before the first votes are cast!](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/NVC79zQtoEGl9kp8l74hbA~~/AARclAA~~~ "That's why I am asking you to chip in 25 bucks right now to get our message out to every voter before the first votes are cast!")**_

_In fact, the Democrat Machine has outraised us to the tune of 50 million dollars. _

**We can 't just sit around praying someone else will step up in these final days. No. That is a recipe for disaster come Election Day.**

Overcoming the Left's historic fundraising edge will take a MONUMENTAL effort from our entire grassroots team. _Yes, that includes you._

subject: Why I'm running
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Dan Ruby
body:
https://www.everyaction.com/ [https://www.everyaction.com/]
Friend,
I am really excited about this run for Congress and the opportunity to be a true representative of our district in the US House through this upcoming important election.
My vision is to help build strong, prosperous communities across Oregon. This means welcoming cities and thriving towns that are vibrant, healthy, and ready for the future. I dream of working families being able to buy homes and afford rent; having quality healthcare available in reach; more providers for primary care and mental health; programs to fight and prevent homelessness and drug addiction; training for good jobs in next-generation industry; and schools that we’re proud of. I know we can do better with fair water use that works for all users, smarter forest management and fighting climate change to reduce wildfires; sensible protection of our landscapes and wildlife, and helping local businesses and small farmers succeed.
I have spent my career in science education, community health, and housing, and have decades of experience working hard on complex problems to achieve shared goals through listening and collaborating with partners, from local leaders to grassroots organizations. I know what it takes to get big things done. I also understand what it was like to be a small business owner through the pandemic.
My goal is to create and support programs and policies that help all of the people in southern, central, and eastern Oregon, not just a few. I vow to protect our individual freedoms and civil liberties from far-right extremists.
Accomplishing this and defeating our MAGA Republican incumbent requires more than just dedication; it needs the support of people like you. Your contribution will be instrumental in advancing our campaign and driving the positive change we need. Donate today to help us build a future that truly fits us all. Thank you for your dedication to a brighter tomorrow.
Dan Ruby

---
| | | Donald Trump's interview with Elon Musk had the usual incoherent nonsense, but with a disturbing addition -- sudden [slurring and lisping](https://default.salsalabs.org/T184bbd33-b47b-45f8-bf43-4cb6e2304c55/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). Listeners across the Internet were left wondering "what the hell is wrong with him?"

When questioned about this, the Trump campaign spokesman dismissed it, saying "there must be something wrong with your ears."

This is not acceptable. Trump's speech issues could be signs of a serious neurological disorder, and we need to know the truth before voters cast their ballots. The Trump campaign needs to explain what it going on NOW.

I’m asking for your support because I’m hoping that, if I lay out why I’m so passionate about this team, this mission, and this work, you’ll believe in this cause strongly enough to contribute your hard-earned money toward its success.
**The fact is, I’m running for re-election proudly on my record of getting big things done for Kansas families.**
By prioritizing results over partisanship and extremism, we’ve saved Kansans on Medicare $620 per year on insulin, created over 20,000 clean-energy jobs here in KS-03, and brought in millions of dollars for rural communities in Kansas to expand broadband access, ensure clean water, and fix aging roads and bridges.
**I’m also proud to be breaking the mold for what people picture when they picture a member of Congress.**
Here’s a brief snapshot of my life before I started serving in Washington: I was raised by a single mom and was the first person from my family to attend college. I juggled multiple jobs to pay my way through school. I then worked in economic and community development on Native American reservations. And when I flipped a Republican-held seat, it made me the first LGBTQ+ Native American elected to Congress.
**And I’m proud to be fighting hard for our values every single day.**
We’re up against extremists who are trying to take away abortion rights, to make life harder for LGBTQ+ Americans, to reduce access to affordable health care, and to undermine our democracy. I’m not afraid to stand up to them and defend our fundamental freedoms — but the reality is, if we’re going to win this fight, we need to flip control of the House. _**And there’s no realistic world in which we flip control of the House without defending this battleground House seat here in KS-03.**_

name: Kirsten Gillibrand
subject: addressing your top priorities
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
| | |
---
As you know, friend, one of the first things I do when meeting voters is grab a pen and open up my notebook.
I listen to their stories, to the problems facing our communities and their ideas for making our government work better — and then I write it all down and take those thoughts with me to Washington.
As much as I wish I could, friend, I can’t meet _everyone_ in person. That’s why I recently asked you to share your feedback with me directly in a survey. I know we ask for your input a lot, but it’s so helpful for informing our strategy and priorities. That’s why I wanted to share a bit of insight into this team's responses:
* **The three issues that are top of mind are reproductive freedom, voting rights and gun safety.** These are all priorities for me, too. That's why I've been fighting to protect and restore reproductive rights by passing the Equal Rights Amendment. It's why I introduced and supported legislation to expand the right to vote. And it's why my federal ban on gun trafficking was included in the first major federal gun safety bill passed in over three decades.

* Over 86% of you said that codifying Roe v. Wade is one of the top priorities — if not _the_ top priority — for you this year. It's been over two years since the Dobbs decision stripped away our basic, fundamental right to reproductive freedom. **No matter how long it takes, I won't stop fighting until we reinstate our right to control our bodies and decide our futures.**

* The top three campaign efforts that survey respondents think Democrats should focus on are voter registration and mobilization, TV and digital advertising and community town halls.**Alongside other New York Democrats, I’ve set up a state-focused campaign called the New York Majority Fund to do just that. Right now, we're enhancing voter file records, ensuring that our phone bank and door-to-door operations are efficient, bringing on more staff and growing our grassroots movement. **

Your stories, your concerns and your priorities are always at the center of everything I do. That's what makes your input so meaningful — because it's what fuels my continued fight in the Senate to secure progress for you and your family.
**It is an honor to do this work, friend, and I'm committed to continuing the fight to protect personal freedoms and save our democracy — but I can't do it alone. That's why I'm counting on grassroots Democrats, like you, to help me reach my $100,000 goal before my mid-month deadline.** **_[So please: Will you rush $5, $25 or more right now to help me defend my must-win seat and keep the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90761531/491581708/-862660935?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5261-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOTY4NTU0Zi1hZjU5LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=00gXTkqtaazzbpuWgAzKKTc2XOvMUls5MZhQhNGq_zw=)_**

**The initiative to end Missouri’s total abortion ban will be on the November ballot.**

Hawley paved the way for Missouri’s abortion ban, co-sponsored a national abortion ban, started a corrupt family business to outlaw the abortion pill, pioneered the legal arguments that now threaten IVF access nationwide, and even recently voted against real protections for birth control and IVF in the Senate.

**
When their rights are under attack, voters turn out in droves to protect their freedoms — whether it’s by overwhelmingly voting to secure abortion rights or by directly rejecting Big Brother politicians like Josh Hawley at the ballot box.
All of this means that we have a historic opportunity in Missouri this year — to restore our freedoms, to end our state’s total abortion ban, and to hold Hawley accountable for making it all happen — and we absolutely can’t afford to waste it.

subject: Catching up with Chuck Morse
body:
| | | |
---
**Exclusive Updates and Behind-the-Scenes Snaps from Chuck's Campaign Journey!**
|
---

******Team Morse had an incredible 'Farm Freedom Fest' hosted by Gus Stratton at Equanimity Farm!**
**From old friends like Executive Councilor Joe Kenney and Wakefield planning board chair Tom Dube, to new supporters from across Carroll, Belknap and Strafford County, it is clear our campaign has the excitement and momentum to win this fall!**
|
---

**Visiting D.S. Cole Growers in Loudon for the New Hampshire Farm Bureau & Timber Association's summer picnic felt like coming home! **
**As someone who started their own nursery and garden center, I know firsthand the importance of protecting these industries and ensuring New Hampshire remains the best place to start and grow a small business.**
**Granite State families work tirelessly to earn a living, and as governor, I’ll work just as hard to ensure they keep more of their hard-earned income. That’s the mentality I’ll bring to Concord every day.**
|
---
****
******Enjoyed stopping by the Hudson Old Home Day with Senate Majority Leader Sharon Carson!**********

A few weeks ago, Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez introduced articles of impeachment against Supreme Court Justices Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas for abusing their positions of power on the highest court in the nation for their own personal gain.
From receiving luxury vacations paid for by conservative donors to spouses asking for free and fair election results to be overturned, it’s clear that the impartiality of the Court has been compromised.
With six out of nine Supreme Court justices consistently ruling in ways that seems to only benefit extremists, we have to ask: [Should Justices Alito and Thomas be impeached and removed from the Supreme Court? August 13, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Proven, Effective, Alaska First: Nancy Dahlstrom is the Best Candidate
in the Race

ANCHORAGE, AK - The verdict is in around Alaska and America: Lt.
Governor Nancy Dahlstrom is the only candidate who can defeat Mary
Peltola in November.

President Donald J. Trump knows it, as do Governor Mike Dunleavy and
Anne Young, the widow of the late Rep. Don Young. Republican leaders
across the country know Dahlstrom is the only candidate that can flip
this seat red and deliver a strong Republican majority for President
Trump's agenda.
Dahlstrom's endorsements
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=71151&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=64335> to date include:

* President Donald J. Trump
* Alaska Governor Mike Dunleavy
* Speaker Mike Johnson
* House Majority Leader Steve Scalise
* House Majority Whip Tom Emmer
* House Republican Conference Chairwoman Elise Stefanik
* Rep. Harriet Hageman, at-large Wyoming GOP congresswoman
* Anne Garland Young
* Winning for Women
* International Union of Police Associations
* Public Safety Employees Association
* Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America
* Elevate PAC (E-PAC)

"I am proud to have the support of Alaskans, Republican leadership,
public safety leaders, and trusted conservatives in my race for
Congress. It's clear that Alaskans are tired of the far-left policies
pushed by Mary Peltola and they know that I can beat her to return
common sense to Washington," said Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom.
"President Trump, Speaker Johnson, and House GOP leadership know that I
will win in November and I will be a voice for Alaska in Congress, and
I look forward to working with them to Make America Great Again."

Friend, Next week, Democratic leaders and delegates from all 50 states and U.S. territories will gather in Chicago for the 2024 Democratic National Convention. They’ll officially nominate the Democratic candidates for President and Vice President, adopt a party platform, host speakers such as past Democratic presidents, and demonstrate the Democratic party’s values to the American people. This is the time Democrats work to unite our party. **Next week’s Democratic National Convention is an opportunity for Democratic candidates and delegates to show they’re listening to and moving with their base of voters.** U.S. Democratic voters have been clear: a vast majority want a permanent ceasefire and to stop arming Israel. The majority of Democratic voters also believe that Israel’s government is committing a genocide against Palestinians. They don’t want their tax dollars to continue funding the mass murder of Palestinian children. Fellow American,
I just heard **_[Jamie Raskins plan to overturn the election if Trump wins](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=d2ab475ecc9540c1bf025e3f2036aa2c&_e=JtpjfTgjhjUwDS8ttLrIn2JpmFEuyL-kl5_s1VbdFjKyU-ntSBEn7ssdlUU5GzBQTjIBAFGcdejfPnuLjezlsT5-g-S_W-wgBE1s0max5cDwX2W4uFqGdm7TJ1GS9EeutHND-SZCsLNwTFjrYEeOxqjEE7tFHC-w2sMpsfqzIjc60LMwxoDSiq10HH2n3arFQ8b5bhWGcNtEs7stgr5yW2mZysMoMMhwxZGG1CxTRiFB9YrVyAqgJYJzqgrMP7IlEtBw0SjSx7h4IL8eMYGJSZsHAcd4UTCsTqhY-Lyo41oYWYEYI5DPqdSSboIHcpnxaIG7peB2mfIiIgezrtL7mjMUrayI_Sj1TGpba8BodbeCjjX65nqlpkaC9nOnqVJRnPGggl_Ff0zLD4rj3N7jqooBI9CRJMDZv7P2z1txlp8%3D)_** , and I'm angry and astonished.
**He's talking to Democrats about needing _“_****bodyguards for everybody and civil war conditions**** _”_****after they disqualify President Trump from holding office.**
**_[This might be the most important email I've ever sent you, and everyone who receives this email needs to read exactly what Raskins said](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=d2ab475ecc9540c1bf025e3f2036aa2c&_e=JtpjfTgjhjUwDS8ttLrIn2JpmFEuyL-kl5_s1VbdFjKyU-ntSBEn7ssdlUU5GzBQTjIBAFGcdejfPnuLjezlsT5-g-S_W-wgBE1s0max5cDwX2W4uFqGdm7TJ1GS9EeutHND-SZCsLNwTFjrYEeOxqjEE7tFHC-w2sMpsfqzIjc60LMwxoDSiq10HH2n3arFQ8b5bhWGcNtEs7stgr5yW2mZysMoMMhwxZGG1CxTRiFB9YrVyAqgJYJzqgrMP7IlEtBw0SjSx7h4IL8eMYGJSbNiNP-g1132euAd5mSm2oQUFL4DkVfZaBhYKGBNkkiwSQDzN2yNlsp5hWX0_EHbnZQbesN6Jow-De3PU__rKCZd_nmsnwXaDkwvj_v4dcyCDW22uZKx9UB8iqnFURYHR9M6cwk6gCgx_DE0seo5xmM%3D)_.**
I've known for a long time that Raskins has Trump Derangement Syndrome, but I never thought he'd plot to destroy our Republic because of it.
There is no question we are in one of America's darkest hours and that evil surrounds us. It can be demoralizing at times, _but we cannot lose sight of why we fight_.
**For our families, our faith, and the last bastion of freedom in the world; the United States of America.**
I refuse to cower in fear and I will not waver in my fight to save the country I love.

I first met Sam Brown in the burn unit. He'd just returned from Afghanistan where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban. He was injured by a roadside bomb and had a long road to recovery. I was assigned as his dietitian in rehab and was very impressed by him. Here was a young man terribly injured while serving his country, but his heart was full of faith. He fought with every fiber of his being to recover so he could return to serve with his men in Afghanistan. And even when it became clear that he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he didn't skip a beat. Sam had to relearn everything. He had prepared for his entire life to spend his career fighting for his country in the military. After his life plans were dashed in just 60 seconds, he re-focused his vision on serving others in a new way. Before we were married, and before we were even dating, Sam and I became friends. I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced, and he was honest with me. He was concerned for my Salvation – and for that matter so was I. He challenged me to reconnect with God and start going to church again. As he and I grew closer, he helped me rediscover my faith. Now here we are 15 years later. We have 3 kids, I'm a Bible-believing momma, and Sam is running for Senate to keep serving our nation and restore hope, leadership, and accountability. I'm endlessly grateful that God put him in my life. Sam is a warrior, a hero, a leader. _**[I'm backing this Purple Heart veteran all the way and I hope you will too.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=889b9553ad3d4c09ae3dce406e64be23&_e=qUGzgaU6lGrHZm9Z8WctYOmfITYxunlp6f6unnoRv6BCHAJGrVBFo566PKZA_UlvDWM-LBMBRYeeS1lzWZEo2MS5aJsaq1SiUkloB1L8sMIrqnPjFykEL49i80RF2GeAOutP81W20XOsO_PFHcWuNMee2c4eJjJlh2gAZqoYaniBp-UrHa7ZQ-z_oMxpCOO52K_COhsFlsYu4s3ElTx_oQZfTUHj0HSgAoRJYpLbbCVd1TBnzWzAK3ncqLM-AP9qWAINQMrxi1fTNjVC9aFFaJvBoFXuCzRqqhawrBusJpAWLvqjiBWfWvQcfZUy-jGADINL06Ml40hE1t58_cTXz8w9kTTNGz-FFFtz-Sd2n6JgdddJym-v-sqzazV0aaWukvSwA_FQ6w3fLm_YCCbDgPbE5u3Y_0flfHs9qg34vS4by24PW8xrRGbLzfXkz3ST6WUwXLw7dIP9JNYA6DYMEQ%3D%3D)**_

If there's a more effective way to limit the impact of people's votes than this plan in Texas -- aside from eliminating the right to vote -- we haven't seen it, Team. Opponents of voting rights in Texas would see their power ensconced for generations if this went through.
This shows why we can't afford to right off even one single state in our fight to protect voting rights. RUSH $25 or more right now to make sure every vote truly counts in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=081324_2&amount=25]

Austin American-Statesman -- Opinion: Cherish your vote and our democracy. Both face new challenges in Texas. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=081324_2&amount=25]
Team,
There's no way to sugarcoat this: A major party is advocating for a constitutional change in Texas that would codify their power and control into the state constitution . From the Austin American-Statesman:
" The Texas Republican Party platform now calls for a state constitutional amendment to create another requirement for winning statewide office: In addition to winning the most votes statewide, a candidate would have to win a majority of the votes in a majority of Texas’ 254 counties. "
This would create a mini-Electoral College just within Texas itself, with one vote for each county. Harris County, home to Houston and nearly 5 million people, would count exactly the same as Loving County, whose population during the 2020 census was recorded as 64 people .
For example, Texas' current governor won reelection with only 55% of the popular vote but "won" 235 counties. This constitutional amendment, if passed, would guarantee no other party could win a statewide election without taking away all those rural, deeply conservative counties. Opponents of voting rights want to use land, not people, to keep themselves in power permanently.
They're openly advocating for anti-democratic rules to limit the impact of people's votes just because they want to stay in control, Team. The road to a Democratic majority in the House runs straight through Virginia. I’m proud to support strong VA Democrats who are running for U.S. House seats, and I hope you’ll join me by reading these emails and chipping in when you can. With your help, we can flip the House and keep Virginia blue! —Tim
Friends,
I’m proud to support Gloria Witt’s campaign for U.S. Congress! Gloria is the Democratic nominee for Virginia’s 5th Congressional district, and she’s running to secure a better future for our children and to protect our most fundamental rights.
She’s going to need our support to flip the district blue in November, so I’m asking: Will you split a donation of any amount between me and Gloria right now to power our campaigns through Election Day? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gloria]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gloria [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gloria]
From a young age, Gloria understood the power of opportunity. Born and raised in Amherst on a small farm, Gloria was involved in all aspects of farm life, and as a teenager, she worked in the tobacco fields every summer. Her father pushed her to pursue a college education, and from there she began a 32-year career in the corporate world.
After retiring, she dedicated herself to giving back to her community and helping others succeed. Gloria has been focused on listening to her community’s struggles so she can fight for them while in Congress – she’ll work to create smart economic growth, address the gun violence epidemic, and create affordable childcare.
I have no doubt that Gloria is the best person to represent the people in Virginia’s 5th district – but she’s going to need our help to win. What changed? the Democrat leaders were so concerned about Biden's ability to win (and the down ballot damage he might cause to House and Senate candidates) that they would take ANYONE that wasn't Biden -- and they only one that could pull it off in the time allowed before critical deadlines was Kamala...

I’m running for re-election to ensure everyone in our district feels seen, heard, and taken care of. Fellow American,
I just heard **_[Jamie Raskins plan to overturn the election if Trump wins](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=9daa1aa1fa9446b8b62545daa4e83429&_e=O70klBQ1RJypC8VS46s-zWU5sRYjfdbs2PAgDUTPpF57QLATshejLaH7o2DAc6hLPhZUE-KOflc6OOTjkVvuRmZ86JVN6TU8hCxsC00Se1LdZdfoEiUIp27HRpys9BCqRuH7uqpof0SR0U37FKAdCi1nF6cvFRWtK-eF9fJuvtaOoXzds1uQ83ihH5PwTzXtpNb88Z09KV0kQL6yxVn9yaVY-8SmFc6ExzhD3tVtPXJGrhQfzKV58X37zU08DLhrxG8S4K1w3V7ljfunsy6bHhkNJCPZQ-la9kQ5buaHdrgCmBuwqmc7lgoExnBF1fLUJYdc3LYx4g-V0JsyXzoMjMRHzi3aYiSpmnN3Btccctsl6EiQ5gt9A_DbZez0gDByJCh-0SHAsJtw6n3Uw1uDTa1wUXxKKoq2WmU6UXnJXFs%3D)_** , and I'm angry and astonished.
**He's talking to Democrats about needing _“_****bodyguards for everybody and civil war conditions**** _”_****after they disqualify President Trump from holding office.**
**_[This might be the most important email I've ever sent you, and everyone who receives this email needs to read exactly what Raskins said](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=9daa1aa1fa9446b8b62545daa4e83429&_e=O70klBQ1RJypC8VS46s-zWU5sRYjfdbs2PAgDUTPpF57QLATshejLaH7o2DAc6hLPhZUE-KOflc6OOTjkVvuRmZ86JVN6TU8hCxsC00Se1LdZdfoEiUIp27HRpys9BCqRuH7uqpof0SR0U37FKAdCi1nF6cvFRWtK-eF9fJuvtaOoXzds1uQ83ihH5PwTzXtpNb88Z09KV0kQL6yxVn9yaVY-8SmFc6ExzhD3tVtPXJGrhQfzKV58X37zU08DLhrxG8S4K1w3V7ljfunsy6bHkwlqaoUfdyDbW1eL1TSrUMGlmIrKRnLcN732ZnIpM-6q7L8QSEyv164IQUnMX12u2uxBN7wlUZKTUoPkordKbFkER7FZjNy8X4vTKVyauLmB1LFEwFL5EYm1Pz-EM0PFRDjKfx3n-SMaJqBQcm8960%3D)_.**
I've known for a long time that Raskins has Trump Derangement Syndrome, but I never thought he'd plot to destroy our Republic because of it.
There is no question we are in one of America's darkest hours and that evil surrounds us. It can be demoralizing at times, _but we cannot lose sight of why we fight_.
**For our families, our faith, and the last bastion of freedom in the world; the United States of America.**
I refuse to cower in fear and I will not waver in my fight to save the country I love.

I first met Sam Brown in the burn unit. He'd just returned from Afghanistan where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban. He was injured by a roadside bomb and had a long road to recovery. I was assigned as his dietitian in rehab and was very impressed by him. Here was a young man terribly injured while serving his country, but his heart was full of faith. He fought with every fiber of his being to recover so he could return to serve with his men in Afghanistan. And even when it became clear that he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he didn't skip a beat. Sam had to relearn everything. He had prepared for his entire life to spend his career fighting for his country in the military. After his life plans were dashed in just 60 seconds, he re-focused his vision on serving others in a new way. Before we were married, and before we were even dating, Sam and I became friends. I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced, and he was honest with me. He was concerned for my Salvation – and for that matter so was I. He challenged me to reconnect with God and start going to church again. As he and I grew closer, he helped me rediscover my faith. Now here we are 15 years later. We have 3 kids, I'm a Bible-believing momma, and Sam is running for Senate to keep serving our nation and restore hope, leadership, and accountability. I'm endlessly grateful that God put him in my life. Sam is a warrior, a hero, a leader. _**[I'm backing this Purple Heart veteran all the way and I hope you will too.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=f52ca08cc240410da723f8dd2cc182e2&_e=ajaxbePYe71sUBYsgg0WoFCt3HjnUR4Jf5qmWc28x-eNs5W6AAyzQ_7ebZsSZ2rf2agf0yX9-BQK2rvv6VU8Y_KXQEUtA3FKm_UnwxiojZ4VisYDWg_GFRvW3OwpKoPZgSaKWo09ZktcnS4Nq6vYqe5VyEcy559g3ElVLoAf3j8r2MLK5nSh8Eat39nto13_mndfNG0QYwwTcKH_39Gb3PUV3iKoDlELkm-r-6U7fOnWYh0srDs_HOhQM-gIGXgy-SDr5UzM14kmzqlBGaNLgzTTUZo2AUpu_WbrN_pgVu9xqkw04jKTrQdQ5_vWmziQLbc9A09iINyIKBHlBsAzLKOOcaBH9cHkd3Lj_iLhBHh8S5s1ZYs3ZM5y-rJq2STUAMXimWGah87xiB8UriijbmqRI70ZbtQ9JcDYRztyZUMMrSGHApxCyTf81fLLkduq)**_

Dear Peter,
People have been asking about the New York case to remove me from the ballot, so let me tell you what it means.
[I’ll still be on the ballot, don’t worry about that. We will appeal this decision and win. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ny_court_ruling_8_13_24_nd1&n=5)
The worry here isn’t about my campaign for President. The worry is about the state of our country. **Basically what this case says is, “We don’t want you to choose.”**
Our campaign took on the 45,000 ballot signature requirement in New York and blew it out of the water. We collected over 135,000 signatures – more than any candidate in history.
But instead of bending to the will of the people, the DNC went behind their back to invalidate their choice.
Did you know that Iran and China have elections? Even the Soviet Union had them. **But you could only vote for state-approved candidates._Well, it’s turning into that here too_.**
As a result, the top 1% now owns more wealth than the 60% in the middle, our entire middle class. And hard working Americans can no longer afford life in America.
We have Kamala Harris – the hand-picked candidate of DNC insiders – now their presidential nominee without having received a single vote. But I’m not an approved candidate, so they’re trying to remove me from the ballot.

body:
We are standing up for veterans, parents, taxpayers, and hard-working Americans.

| |
---
| | |
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm the Democrats #1 target.

In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. They are already spending big bucks to try and defeat me, so I wanted to see if you would be willing to support our campaign.

But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place.

---
| [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=35501051986844b7adbaa6a17a8eff78&_e=FjGfbG0R76OTqL7A773GkdgjL3E86pPOcH31szC4REufmCjwIqBuCc7O_6MkqJb5tEGRfxDNqMrtcui2uZIGLq0GJpcKUXDZiw8aH2JPNpEJRks041t1dHyOteMXoBvq16vKjChlFpG-L8FGLOc235k4hj7KgV0D9lqs7siBNHv2sX281LZzf2tQVFL2VZ9bt0DlDBMyDu4Gq2ex-O90wTJphzeDo_lJZvDOM-O5sLbjjffwvbi0pLmO88NaQ78bmpdT5fALWVH_UxXdCov5Vskee3HYgi1A_u-WCjXrzGtVc0ypt68lqxAhK6HqXab79RNqAO2K0oGPSsXoVfIbgXWAt-I119HkuThu5qyVQ_DOy5R_Pfz4-P9FnjevyDe5NMgJNJzxq_Wjnci7VbqqmQ%3D%3D)
---

That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I'm a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children.

---
| [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=35501051986844b7adbaa6a17a8eff78&_e=FjGfbG0R76OTqL7A773GkdgjL3E86pPOcH31szC4REufmCjwIqBuCc7O_6MkqJb5tEGRfxDNqMrtcui2uZIGLq0GJpcKUXDZiw8aH2JPNpEJRks041t1dHyOteMXoBvq16vKjChlFpG-L8FGLOc235k4hj7KgV0D9lqs7siBNHv2sX281LZzf2tQVFL2VZ9bt0DlDBMyDu4Gq2ex-O90wTJphzeDo_lJZvDOM-O5sLYnFDL641gX4uYL7LLgjFmpE9urW1yFIcNBVW8QxwsFfWOaHFFX0T_vpwNlie1WTk-AbzMmEOOJhjwWsNnHgkDKXGJNcP3B_6v2i9sYM9tWswfBeRlEI1HFS-tk2hiSp4ygWyUJLZJkVfLT0rOwD8SP6lwbVmsZsoTt2OOezRflDA%3D%3D)
---

I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - "Blossom." I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf.

After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve.

---
| [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=35501051986844b7adbaa6a17a8eff78&_e=FjGfbG0R76OTqL7A773GkdgjL3E86pPOcH31szC4REufmCjwIqBuCc7O_6MkqJb5tEGRfxDNqMrtcui2uZIGLq0GJpcKUXDZiw8aH2JPNpEJRks041t1dHyOteMXoBvq16vKjChlFpG-L8FGLOc235k4hj7KgV0D9lqs7siBNHv2sX281LZzf2tQVFL2VZ9bt0DlDBMyDu4Gq2ex-O90wTJphzeDo_lJZvDOM-O5sLaHSKA8XEujY5hZu5zPprXBccDtsWvyD9yeqhhSecl-TdBRCatFauwJzSRaMQjOryremyzVVeluNp9WGkl39uiiRD-FSj-qPSasfzxMEw7wWN9aYGdYNZcsLckcydXYD2myMAKRiU0OWt7yJy4KTTI13RTixHdFlj5uW_1663SjEA%3D%3D)
---

Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I'm not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them.

_**So I got off my couch, and I ran for office.**_

---
| [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=35501051986844b7adbaa6a17a8eff78&_e=FjGfbG0R76OTqL7A773GkdgjL3E86pPOcH31szC4REufmCjwIqBuCc7O_6MkqJb5tEGRfxDNqMrtcui2uZIGLq0GJpcKUXDZiw8aH2JPNpEJRks041t1dHyOteMXoBvq16vKjChlFpG-L8FGLOc235k4hj7KgV0D9lqs7siBNHv2sX281LZzf2tQVFL2VZ9bt0DlDBMyDu4Gq2ex-O90wTJphzeDo_lJZvDOM-O5sLYAR8EbeDEk3jyXXcorFzzAE2m8cFYN6x2HJ-ccmNr5EZ657LqYd_frS6lMPLV63hgINTMzAZLLTyUS00H1cPyRG3PI3aDKMzhaB5glAQAiSs9I4OQ4gM9IReaz7_Hc4imtt4uIL65Oc-90tiHeRGeGL_8pc3rTlE-gd1Qsc4XsFg%3D%3D)
---

I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities.

Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first.

---
| [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=35501051986844b7adbaa6a17a8eff78&_e=FjGfbG0R76OTqL7A773GkdgjL3E86pPOcH31szC4REufmCjwIqBuCc7O_6MkqJb5tEGRfxDNqMrtcui2uZIGLq0GJpcKUXDZiw8aH2JPNpEJRks041t1dHyOteMXoBvq16vKjChlFpG-L8FGLOc235k4hj7KgV0D9lqs7siBNHv2sX281LZzf2tQVFL2VZ9bt0DlDBMyDu4Gq2ex-O90wTJphzeDo_lJZvDOM-O5sLYyYnPpsXG2K1JisemXO05jG6CN8wCffQ_iWrnSBAb-GK10fjXsoWypwoUs7yiYlwfW5o0etue-GVhwYBMDmrSYxemPROGHJm1VvataUpADjB-F9DxNBaoAVpmT82nu-H2oStQIEny2Ma3UbL1wg4mC-6rn7wmwJHuuAXmdgb9ZQA%3D%3D)
---

So, I once again decided to stop complaining and _actually do something about it_. So I ran for Congress!

When I commit to something, I give it my all, and that's what we did with the campaign. We were up against a lot. National Democrats poured over $10 million into my opponent's campaign, and big money PACs spent even more attacking me.

---
| [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=35501051986844b7adbaa6a17a8eff78&_e=FjGfbG0R76OTqL7A773GkdgjL3E86pPOcH31szC4REufmCjwIqBuCc7O_6MkqJb5tEGRfxDNqMrtcui2uZIGLq0GJpcKUXDZiw8aH2JPNpEJRks041t1dHyOteMXoBvq16vKjChlFpG-L8FGLOc235k4hj7KgV0D9lqs7siBNHv2sX281LZzf2tQVFL2VZ9bt0DlDBMyDu4Gq2ex-O90wTJphzeDo_lJZvDOM-O5sLYuZs6A9lPhXsRlFV8qKJ0wDPtWT0UM2l6zk7wjsMToB3lOJpQG2LW_ejlxGTtTJfY5tylscduO4Fbf1DjowCUioQhYTl4TAN5jq-kJ1K2b0C2vyWxawVDEBNgD0VLQvE60Vau0wAFh_yyY3IzdXOvpBXw2aa1Qo_CwsYukJlo6gg%3D%3D)
---

But, we stayed focused on the task at hand and never lost sight of why I was running. On Election Night, we won by about 10,000 votes in one of the closest races in the entire nation.

And in Congress, we've already been able to make a big impact. **We are standing up for veterans, parents, taxpayers, and hard-working Americans.** We're making good progress, but the work is just getting started.

---
| [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=35501051986844b7adbaa6a17a8eff78&_e=FjGfbG0R76OTqL7A773GkdgjL3E86pPOcH31szC4REufmCjwIqBuCc7O_6MkqJb5tEGRfxDNqMrtcui2uZIGLq0GJpcKUXDZiw8aH2JPNpEJRks041t1dHyOteMXoBvq16vKjChlFpG-L8FGLOc235k4hj7KgV0D9lqs7siBNHv2sX281LZzf2tQVFL2VZ9bt0DlDBMyDu4Gq2ex-O90wTJphzeDo_lJZvDOM-O5sLZXuPhPCAEBZM24cxQHBfUY6MR4ZuffZRGocrA8EFOqRKbOTXASeYd4nbgiUaEq33MJYVdWiRu7t7r_60y4H1cj4w913b4mv-A6jvb05riS0RB133-zu832Y82UqFl88vHlkjp_KbOtoFgQl2tPoT1CO5uDs6re3tpjsTdJNBZ55w%3D%3D)
---

**But the Democrats and their deep pocket donors are already setting out to defeat me.** The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee has announced my seat is one of their top targets in 2024, so I'm hoping you will donate today to help our campaign keep going strong.

---
| | [KEEP JEN IN THE FIGHT](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=35501051986844b7adbaa6a17a8eff78&_e=FjGfbG0R76OTqL7A773GkdgjL3E86pPOcH31szC4REufmCjwIqBuCc7O_6MkqJb5tEGRfxDNqMrtcui2uZIGLq0GJpcKUXDZiw8aH2JPNpEJRks041t1dHyOteMXoBvq16vKjChlFpG-L8FGLOc235k4hj7KgV0D9lqs7siBNHv2sX281LZzf2tQVFL2VZ9bt0DlDBMyDu4Gq2ex-O90wTJphzeDo_lJZvDOM-O5sLb0VkQxb0wYYJKZkKdtFjKcEVrURW5h6Xxf6mHc2wnW3FsRVZ_j9Q4N767CZHg5IPrG3iIVzi6BBmAojL5ofVMYQ3PoFUgEUPBBNvOTXeX1sLyH2ttZsN-msl7XfTZtlWPR_JAzlgnf9Ev_IFktvr0iQKpWa7fv7nbkkbZ2sf3kFg%3D%3D "DONATE TO JEN KIGGANS")
---

If you want to see more regular, everyday citizens in office instead of career politicians, then I need your urgent help. Can you spare anything to help me defeat the Democrats in this #1 Battleground race?

I can't stand sending messages like this. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if I never got off the couch and ran for office...but then I remember that America is always worth protecting...no matter what!

Thanks for reading my message. I hope I was able to earn your support.

In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place. | That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve. | Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. Peter, This past weekend we sent an urgent message about Jill’s ballot access situation in 5 states and we wanted to make sure it didn't slip through the cracks. We need to raise tens of thousands of dollars in the next few weeks or millions of voters in Minnesota, Delaware, Alabama, Virginia, and Rhode Island will not have an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate emergency candidate alternative in November. The deadline for collecting signatures in these states is coming up fast. In Minnesota and Delaware, we have until August 20th. In Alabama and Virginia, the deadline is August 23rd, and Rhode Island’s deadline is September 6th. _**It’s no exaggeration to say that if we don’t raise a significant amount of money in the next few days, Jill will lose ballot access in Minnesota, Delaware, Alabama, Virginia, and Rhode Island.**_ So many people stepped up to donate the last few days- but we still need about $48,000 to reach our goal. **[Peter, we need supporters like you to give as much as you can today. Janelle Stelson has spent her career advocating for truth and integrity, and now she's running to unseat extremist Scott Perry and represent Pennsylvania's 10th District in Congress. If you’d like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/57CdP-wFgkuQm58EpOgxvQ2?unsubscribedata=85U%2BQhyAvUHmHCqJ52DkKoeMsVAdjvnmPeMu4FjLsWbZNCKLk1CeQTZaDyP%2BGU6zICbwcisYPzRqO1NHmfg%2F8y7oJA%2FHRVWcC5iYqb9jMnQPL2FowWiBvUkSGK7MkUQUlASMwO0R%2FynfELn632CoS8iRcJcpP%2FNZfu1EItRlSKbguswFfgST%2FF8%2B2ys%2Ffqh8%2BG1cPA1lveM%2Bt%2FFQ6swkNu95xX3UKPs674kcP3%2BD6i3UBo0bQ5GbWLTsEU%2FXL7puecAXs4Gp5Px00gxjj%2BQT4rWC9z%2F%2FRbbKLrBPmlRxnQwQogA3Ch7spPCzjJ1T6aqD3uuiKVa3oJ9SUnhKBzrGaQU%2FkDtN%2BTwexcGGUcFvnGpD5EDSR9zVmHpj%2B0FIT79r1G68l%2F3u5%2BuAH2MEI6BK9EQEZNJqjbWMWpRKBAvP741oFD8eh1p2kblhzKvoi0Ri)

Here at Team Stelson HQ, we’re racing against the clock to raise $10K for Janelle Stelson’s campaign for Congress before Friday at midnight. And the fact of the matter is, we’re 28% behind where we should be right now. Frankly, we’re a little stressed! But we’ll be real with you for a second: We know you’re getting a lot of emails asking for money this week from a lot of different candidates and politicians. So we wanted to take just a minute to explain why this deadline actually matters. ([If you want Scott Perry out of office or want to support a Democrat with strong values like Janelle, you can donate here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90769279/491608258/-850283373?source=JS_EM_FR_081324_Convinced&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3MTMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDE2YzlmMGItYzI1OS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=CVJW9TYzKyzBrONpXEZxdv3gEAxAyVQmw7RsuB5T_NE=) But if you need to be convinced, read on...) So what are the stakes?
Last fall, Janelle’s opponent Congressman Scott Perry was ordered to turn over his cell phone to federal prosecutors. They investigated his cell phone because he conspired to throw out our votes and tried to overthrow the government on January 6th. Not only that, Perry was appointed by House Speaker Mike Johnson to OVERSEE the FBI...That doesn’t make ANY sense! He’s also in favor of a national abortion ban, and actively votes AGAINST the interests of central Pennsylvanians. **Scott Perry is a slimy politician, and PA-10 deserves better. Period.** Why does this deadline matter?
This deadline is a big deal because we’re just three months out from Election Day, and we can’t afford to take any risks. Hitting our goals and meeting our deadlines is more critical than ever — because every goal hit amps up our momentum and ensures Janelle has everything she needs to finally defeat Scott Perry. If MAGA dark money groups think Janelle looks vulnerable for even a second, they’re going to give Scott Perry _even more_ of their dirty dollars! [We refuse to let that happen.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90769280/491608259/-850283373?source=JS_EM_FR_081324_Convinced&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3MTMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDE2YzlmMGItYzI1OS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=CVJW9TYzKyzBrONpXEZxdv3gEAxAyVQmw7RsuB5T_NE=) And where is my money going?
Your generous donation would help Janelle pay her staffers, help buy door knocking literature and water bottles for volunteers. Your donation helps pay for the software we need to target the right voters so that Janelle can reach out and share her story. And your donation helps us share Janelle’s powerful message far and wide across PA-10. _So did we convince you, team?_ [If you’re on board in our efforts to oust Scott Perry and send Janelle to fight for us in Congress, donate $10, $25, or even $50 right now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90769281/491608260/-850283373?amount=25&source=JS_EM_FR_081324_Convinced&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3MTMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDE2YzlmMGItYzI1OS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=CVJW9TYzKyzBrONpXEZxdv3gEAxAyVQmw7RsuB5T_NE=) | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now.

| Peter,

While extremist Republicans spread mounds of misinformation about what abortion care truly looks like and fight tooth and nail to strip us of our rights, women in pro-life states are suffering daily.

body:
I want to reiterate Eric's unwavering commitment to protecting the fundamental rights that define our American way of life.
Peter
,

Thank you for being a valued supporter of Congressman Eric Burlison. I want to reiterate Eric's unwavering commitment to protecting the fundamental rights that define our American way of life—our freedom of speech, religion, the right to bear arms, the sanctity of life, reduced taxation, and the need to shrink government overreach.

Since taking office in Congress, Eric has tirelessly worked on these priorities.

Further, he has championed efforts to expand access to healthcare, protect property rights, and expand worker freedom.

Eric has been at the forefront of protecting our borders, ending funding to globalist organizations like the WEF, and reining in EPA overreach.

Eric's dedication to conservative principles is reflected in his record.

He received high ratings from Heritage Action (100%), Club for Growth (100%), CPAC (100%), and the Institute of Legislative Analysis (97.62%). This makes Eric Burlison the most conservative member of Congress from Missouri.

We are grateful to have your support as Eric continues to fight for the values we hold dear. Your support is crucial in this fight. Together, we can ensure that our freedoms are protected and that our government remains accountable to the people.

Thank you for standing with us!

And for our children to be free to go to school without worrying they’ll be shot dead in their classrooms. For education to be a ticket to the middle class, not crippling debt. For air that’s clean. [**If you’re in a place where you can make a contribution to support my re-election campaign today, it would be a huge help. I’ll explain why:**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2548?t=9&akid=2306%2E4032634%2EMA5Mf8) Now that we’re in the thick of campaign season, and our primary election in Massachusetts is closely approaching, we are required to report our fundraising results more often. And our next deadline is coming up this week. Since our last fundraising report, a Super PAC supporting my Republican opponent (a crypto-lawyer from Rhode Island recruited to run against me) raked in $2 million from three massive donations — from two crypto billionaires and one big crypto firm. To put that into perspective: Those donations are over half a million more than our campaign had raised in total during our last fundraising quarter. Just like that. **It’s absolutely critical that we show strength on this upcoming fundraising report. And this grassroots campaign relies on a large number of supporters pitching in a little at a time, instead of a small number of billionaires and special interests pitching in a lot at a time.** [**I’m proud of running a grassroots campaign like this — but it can only work if we all pitch in when we can. So if you’re able, will you please contribute $28 or anything you can right now to respond to this Super PACs funding with a strong surge of grassroots support and demonstrate strength on our next fundraising report?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2548?amount=28&t=10&akid=2306%2E4032634%2EMA5Mf8)

On top of showing strength on our next public report, here’s what your donation would help accomplish:
* Supplying the resources we need to run a strong campaign in Massachusetts, compete against any influences from special interest groups trying to buy this election, and hold onto our Senate majority.
* Building momentum for our plans for big, bold action — like universal child care, a wealth tax, a guaranteed nationwide right to an abortion, ethics reform at the Supreme Court, and a whole lot more.
* Taking power out of the hands of special interests, greedy CEOs, and wealthy insiders and putting it where it belongs: in the hands of working people.

Look, August, September, and October are some of the most critical months of an election year — when most spending takes place. They’ve got their handful of special interest donors, but we’ve got each other.
